eps.d: Sarah is hospitalised when a joyride with her friends in Kurt's car goes disastrous. Louise's 17th birthday ends in tears over her cheating boyfriend. Kurt sets his sights on Natasha.
Natasha and Dawn worry about Louise in the aftermath of the break-up. Kurt receives bad news about his car.

Ollie has a terrible day when he loses both his money to Kurt and his girlfriend to Tony. Tickets for the Ragmoor Park concert prove as rare as gold dust, while Natasha tries to console Louise but her stock of sympathy is running low.
Louise's morale reaches an all-time low, while Natasha finds a shoulder to cry on. Tony's love life is still intact, but the same cannot be said for his bike.

Kurt takes the opportunity to throw a party in the Bensons' absence, but has to take measures to protect himself from Louise's advances. When Ollie turns up uninvited, she's reminded that not all's fair in love and war. Maddie plays fairy godmother to Dawn, whilst Jambo causes a stir with his choice of date - Margaret the Cow!

Terry is making Dawn's life a misery at home, while Jambo's new friend proves unpopular with everyone else - and he's told to put him out to pasture. Julie finds out the path to true love never runs smoothly, while Tony looks like losing his job - can Dawn and Natasha save the day?

Jambo discovers that every cow has a silver lining while Kurt's worried about Tony, who's been missing all night. Natasha is determined to sort out Sarah's life with a proposed trip to Alton Towers - but is she really thinking of her own love life?

As the two parties plan to rendezvous at Alton Towers, those travelling with Bazz discover that he is on a different wavelength. Kurt finds himself outvoted, as the others decide to go off in search of little green men.

Quick-thinking Ollie saves Lucy from great embarrassment. Jambo sees his glamorous companion's true identity finally unveiled, and Kurt eagerly prepares for a seasonal kissathon with his trusty mistletoe.

The Bensons party while their parents are away, and Ollie has a smashing time, forcing Jambo and Tony to help him out of a predicament. Kurt's friends plot to get him together with Natasha, but the pair themselves remain stubborn, and Natasha resolves to keep her distance in the new year.

Max discovers the downside of excessive drinking and as Ollie tries to dig himself out of a hole over Mandy, Lewis pushes him further back in. Julie attempts to develop her relationship with Tony, but he is strangely reluctant.
Julie becomes listless when Tony rejects her and Jambo meets the woman of his dreams. Ollie tries to escape from his troubles by hiding out in army camouflage.
Zara finds herself in a passionate clinch, whilst Lisa keeps Ellie company as they see the New Year in together. (Part 1)
Ruth is disappointed when Tony rejects her advances and the kids on the New Year trip hear strange noises in the woods. (Part 2)
Lee dashes Abby's hopes. (Part 3)

Sophie tries to convince a less than keen Darlene and Mel to help with the preparations for the opening of Body Boost. Debbie tries her best to get Ellie to remember the horrific night with Toby but it ends in frustration when Sally interrupts. Meanwhile, Max and Darren have a disagreement.

Body Boost is due to open but the day goes awfully, especially when Dan makes a surprise appearance. Max and Darren's disagreement escalates when they have to be split up before things get out of hand. Debbie is more annoyed that her family are more bothered about the opening of Body Boost then her problems with the Hunters.

Max and Darren reluctantly go to anger management session with their dads. Frankie feels guilty and talks to Jake, since Johnno is busy with Richard, and is shocked for what Jake has to say to her. Joe and Robbie come up with a plan to try and woo Mel and Sophie.

Max and Darren gloat over the repercussions of their therapy sessions. Frankie pitches an idea to Jake and Debbie so her and Johnno can spend more time together. Robbie is getting a little frustrated with Joe's ideas.
Jake and Debbie contemplate life as the owners of the family home. Joe decides to look for a model to fashion his clothing designs. Darren feels guilty about taking the mick out of Jack.

The police want to question Ellie but Sally stalls them. Joe enlists the help of Cameron and Zara, much to Robbie's jealousy as Joe is talking to a lot more women then he is. Jack and Darren put their differences aside.

Nick and Kristian are left unimpressed by their new flatmate. Izzy and Ben try to get used to married life. Mandy gets wound up over Tony and Ruth, whilst Dan is desperate for Ellie's memory to return.

Helen warns Mandy to be wary of Ruth, so Becca offers her support. Dan is starting to worry about prison, so he heads to The Loft to try and cut out the thoughts. Joe and Robbie compete to woo Dannii.

Joe persuades Dannii to model some of his fashion designs and a jealous Robbie tells Dannii that Joe is gay. Les, with the help of Scott, takes a drunk Dan home and when Dan starts to talk prison, Sally starts to worry herself - Debbie does her best to keep the faith also. Richard and Liz force Justin and Ali to work in Body Boost for some work experience. Tony and Ruth can't fight off their lust.

Justin and Ali make the most working in Body Boost by installing a hidden webcam in the girls changing room. Sally goes to see Ellie and there is a tiny sign of progress. Becca gets suspicious of Tony and follows him. Scott and Izzy enjoy flirting, but Emma gets the wrong end of the stick.

Becca is seething with Tony after catching him in the act with Ruth. Mel and Sophie are horrified when they find a camera in the girls changing rooms, so they confront Johnno, whom they accuse of planting. The Hunters wait on news for Ellie, whilst Dan waits at home on his own. Emma apologises to Izzy.

Ellie returns home to find her family in tatters. Tony does his best to talk Becca round and calm Ruth down, but Helen overhears everything - making matters worse for Tony. Darlene starts to keep an eye on Justin without his knowledge, and Justin can't help but brag to Lee and Bombhead about the camera set up.

Lisa tries to get Ellie to tell the truth. but Sally tells Lisa not to rush her. Dan can't stand the troubles at home so he goes to the Deans' to see Debbie. Mandy and Ruth talk about Tony around the pool, unknown to Becca as Tony continues to that promise nothing else is going on. Justin faces the wrath of Darlene so he puts all the blame on Ali.

After calling on the help of Mel and Sophie to find the culprit responsible for the camera set up in the girls changing rooms, Justin enlists the help of Bombhead, who sets off the fire alarms but Darlene catches him and Bombhead can't help but worship everything she does and says.

Darlene entices Bombhead to the pool for her latest prank, whilst Johnno and Richard are left confused after discovering that the alarm was tampered with. Debbie is furious with Steph, whilst the Hunters prepare Dan for the worst - which happens when he is arrested. Gordon isn't feeling himself and everyone is shocked when he collapses.

Helen, Max and Mandy all struggle to come to terms with Gordon's heart attack. Les asks Will if Dan has a chance and is saddened to hear what Will tells him, so Emma does her best to assure Les that there is always a chance. Bombhead is feeling a bit embarrassed by Darlene's prank so he hides for the day.

Max and O.B. spend an uncomfortable night at the hospital while they wait on news on Gordon. Ben gets suspicious when he sees his dad talking to Emma. The Hunters and Debbie get the news that Dan is being held on remand, but is not yet being transferred to Longmere Prison.

Zara finally tells Lisa that she slept with Lee, and Abby is distraught at the reveal. Gordon makes tiny progress and Helen plans a party, but Tony doesn't think it's a good idea. Ben confronts Emma and asks her why she has been around Will quite often, but Emma rests his mind. However, Izzy feels that Ben is jealous...

Robbie and Joe hold their first 'Fake Tan' meeting. Abby confronts Zara and ends up slapping her. A fight breaks out and Lee and Ben have to split it up, but when they find out why they are fighting, Ben punches Lee. Ruth has an idea, but Darren is not so sure that she should go through with it.
Mandy tells Ruth exactly what she thinks of her after Ruth's article makes the press. Lisa and Steph lock horns after Lisa overhears Lisa bad mouthing Dan, whilst Abby checks to see if Lee is okay.
Mr C recovers from his heart attack in the comfort of his own home, while Ellie shocks Lee and Lisa with her decision to speak out against Dan at the trial.
Jake tries desperately to cut back his family's spending.
Ellie attend Toby's funeral; Ben struggles to get closer to Izzy.
Ellie reminisces about happier times.
Jake patches things up with Debbie.
Lisa is increasingly frustrated at Ellie's refusal to tell the truth.
Scott returns to Hollyoaks.
Gordon launches his election campaign and Darren buys himself an expensive suit. With his dad's credit card.
Ben chooses a lads' night out over an evening with Izzy -- who's none too impressed and lets it be known.
It's Friday the 13th, in case you hadn't noticed. Bombhead has and doesn't like it one bit.

Max and Mandy receive some devastating news about their parents - they and Tom are in hospital following a car accident. They are all left distraught when Mr. C dies from a heart attack. Izzy tries to get Ben in the mood for Valentines Day, while Justin and Darlene do their best to disrupt their parents' Valentine plans.

Tony arrives at hospital to comfort Mandy. Izzy decides it's high time she took Ben window-shopping for flats. Grounded Darlene attempts to escape her punishment. Craig hits on an idea to bring some money into the Dean household.

Jake returns home to find the Dean household has turned into an archaeological dig. Ben and Izzy find Emma clutching her stomach in pain. Max and Mandy take Tom to see Helen in hospital. Sophie tries to cheer Darlene up after being grounded.

Ben rushes to be by the side of Emma when she goes into hospital. Darlene tries to rope Ali into causing trouble in the village. Mandy prepares the home for Helen's homecoming. Craig is intent on going through with his moneymaking scam.
Max and Mandy are dealt a cruel shock. Izzy wonders if she can cope with the idea of the new baby. Darlene pushes everyone to the limit, whilst Scott gives Darren an offer he can't reject.

Izzy isn't happy with the amount of time Ben's spending with his newborn son. Max is trying to hold it together for Tom's sake. Darren's ready to show Scott that he's not just a kid. Lee's concerned about not having done his English essay.

Bombhead's finding it difficult to come to terms with Mr C's death. Izzy's angry with herself for telling Will the truth about Emma's baby - she's dreading Ben finding out. Max is feeling the pressure of having to sort out the funeral arrangements alone. Craig's desperate for work and is delighted when Darren offers him a day's trial at The Loft.

It's a constant battle between Max and Mandy when it comes to the funeral arrangements. Steph's on to a winner when she bets everyone they can't give up things that matter to them for Lent. Ben's miserable without Izzy and tries to contact her. Darren's careful not to mention who he's working for when Mr Osborne tells him how proud he is of him for getting a job.

Max says an emotional goodbye when Mr C's body arrives home. Lee's worried about Lisa after finding out she cheated on her essay. Ben's relieved to have Izzy back home, but everything is far from OK. The Deans open their doors for their first Roman Experience.
It's a sad day in Hollyoaks as everyone attends the funeral. Lee's exasperated with Lisa - she needs to get on with her life, but she's already given up. Darren agrees to run an errand for Scott...
Tony attempts to worm his way back into Mandy's affections as she struggles to cope with the aftermath of the funeral.
Ben tells Abby the truth about Emma and the baby, and Mel believes Sophie is cramping her style.
Chloe is not impressed when the opening night of the Student Union bar is a disaster.
The students pull out all the stops to get the SU bar open after the previous night's fiasco.
Joe and Danni become rivals in the SU bar's DJ competition.
Max is furious when Cindy puts the house and businesses up for sale; and Lee is alarmed by Bombhead's decision to become a priest.
Emma leaves Ben devastated by refusing to let him be part of his son's life.
Bombhead struggles to control his feelings for Zara.
Izzy admits that she feels guilty about taking her problems out on the baby.
Johnno becomes the maintenance technician at Body Boost. Nice job.

Ellie's return revives problems between her and Lisa. Max reaches breaking point when placed under pressure by Cindy. Izzy is furious when Emma makes Ben look after Arthur, whilst Chloe decides to begin an "ultimate student" competition.
Dan tells Will about Ellie's confession. Bombhead and Max bond on a fishing trip. Robbie and Mel win Chloe's pool tournament, whilst Izzy and Ben continue to fight over Arthur.
Will tries to get a confession from Ellie. Ben and Izzy get lost on a day out off-road driving. Bombhead holds a tribute ceremony for Mr. C, whilst Robbie wins the fashion design competition.

Scott helps Ellie prepare for court. Izzy tries to fix things with Ben, but he mistakenly, drunkenly gets into bed with Zara! Joe wins the curry-eating competition, whilst Mandy decides to sell Washed Up to Tony.

Cindy returns to Spain after Mandy informs her about the sale of Washed Up. Mel is left jealous when Sophie and Joe share a kiss. Emma is furious when she finds Arthur by himself, whilst the winner of the student competition is announced.
Max questions Mandy's ability to look after Tom properly.
Lisa and Ellie realise that their mum is struggling to cope.
Sally is horrified to discover Dan has been beaten up in prison.

Abby discovers it was Cameron who organised her party. Ellie is shocked when she sees Lisa updating the FreeDanHunter website. Max is increasingly fed up with Mandy interfering in the business. The Deans quiz D.I. Davies about Dan's trial and realise Debbie will need their support.
Debbie confronts Ellie about protecting Toby.

Craig, Justin and Ali worry about the package and things get a lot harder when Liz gets in the way. Mandy is struggling looking after Tom so Tony helps out the best he can. Mel and Sophie play a trick on Bombhead and Joe and they get Robbie in on their plan.

Lee is forced to break some bad news to a hospital-bound Sally. The Deans celebrate finding a buyer for their house. Mandy decides to send Tom to boarding school, much to Max's annoyance. Nick is horrified to find Robbie is making himself comfortable.

Max finds it hard to cope with his grief. Ali tries to keep his secret under wraps - while Justin is loving every minute of it. Dannii is becoming fed up with Robbie's habits. Ellie considers leaving, and then bumps into Debbie who makes matters worse.
Max is ashamed after trashing Drive 'n' Buy. Lee and Lisa take their concerns over Mr Hunter out on Ellie. Chloe suspects a thief is at large at the SU Bar. Ali and Justin attend parents evening.

Lisa shows she's willing to do what she can to protect Dan. Mandy finds it difficult to leave Tony alone with Tom. Robbie gets caught red-handed and is forced to pay the price. Natalie begins to pursue Mr Taylor.

Dan's day begins in the back of a prison van heading to court for the start of his trial. Mandy is feeling pressured by Tony after he expresses concerns over her behaviour - especially her attitude towards Tom. Panic sets in when Kristian thinks he's going bald and resorts to having a hairpiece made to disguise the problem. Natalie decides what she wants - and it just happens to be Mr Taylor!
Ellie keeps her cool in the witness box as she testifies against Dan.

Dan takes the stand and everyone's praying that he can convince the jury of his innocence. Kristian brags about his night of passion with Stacey, hoping to make Dannii jealous. Mandy holds interviews for a new nanny but Max is furious when he finds out.

Lisa is determined to try and help Dan's case when she gives evidence. Tom starts wetting the bed and Tony suspects that it could be because Mandy isn't giving him what he wants - attention. Dannii is determined to teach Kristian a lesson and, with Nick's help, convinces him that Stacey is stalking him!

Time is running out for Dan as the trial comes to a close. Will Ellie tell the truth in time? Mandy is shocked when Max admits that he's been testing her ability to care for their brother. Kristian is petrified of Stacey - she's obsessed with him!

Izzy makes a shocking discovery - she's pregnant! Is this the thing to fix her and Ben's marriage? Meanwhile, love is in the air for Norman when a mysterious stranger drifts into The Dog in the Pond...
It's drinks all around in The Dog in the Pond to celebrate Izzy's good news, whilst Dan delivers a bombshell to an unsuspecting Debbie.
Norman is left with his hands full, whilst Ben struggles having to run around after both Izzy and Emma.
Dan is subject to some jailhouse rock, and Izzy chokes on her words.

Izzy suffers severe abdominal pains. Norman braces himself for a candlelit dinner with Caroline. Ellie sneaks out to visit her mum in hospital. The Deans make waves over their choice of temporary housing.

Izzy struggles to cope and Emma's desperation to proceed with the christening makes things worse. Liz struggles with the lack of manners within the Dean family. Cameron is annoyed when Zara obsesses over Abby's problems, whilst Max offers O.B. a place to stay.
Craig and Steph abuse Liz's hospitality.
Lisa is less than impressed when Ellie takes it upon herself to cook a family meal.
Les overhears Ellie making a shocking confession, while Max and OB revisit their childhoods.
It's Arthur's christening, but Emma and Alison are unable to put their feud aside.
Izzy confides in Chloe about her hospital visit.
Darlene enjoys the trouble she has caused.
Darlene realises she's made a terrible mistake when she hears Justin and Mel discussing Richard's past.
Izzy can't bring herself to talk to Ben about the real reason why she is depressed.
Ben reassures Izzy that her well-being is the only thing that matters to him. Today, anyway.
Lisa refuses to stay under the same roof as Ellie. (Part 1)
Mel goes all out to impress Kristian on their double date, but he seems more taken with her twin sister. (Part 2)
Pressing concerns at the juice bar -- Ellie's managed to secure a job there but isn't entirely sure that Richard will want to keep her on.
Mel's new image causes a stir.
Mel realises that Kristian was only ever interested in a one-night stand with her and turns her mind to thoughts of revenge in the company of fellow traveller Sophie.
Izzy's utterly shaken by Emma's accusations, not realising there may be worse to come.
Cameron concentrates on his revision, unaware that Zara is preparing to make her move on Lee.
Ben tries to convince Izzy they still have a future together, but can't stop her from taking drastic action.
Izzy returns home after staying out all night -- which is good -- but then tells Ben where she's been -- which is not good.
Cameron tells Abby the truth about Zara and Lee. Ben heads to the Loft for revenge.

Due to Steph and Craig clashing at home, Jake sets out to find a sofa and gets what he bargains for when one of his mates sells him one for a good price. However Johnno also buys a sofa after Richard tells him where to get one for cheap, but things go from bad to worse when Craig admits to Steph that he stole Jake's credit card and also bought a sofa.

Liz's day goes from bad to worse as she finds herself clashing with the Deans again all day. As she sits in the sun, all she can hear is more arguing between Steph and Craig. Lee and Robbie try to impress Sophie and Mel by trying to make them think they know it all. Jack asks Tony to help get Darren pulling his weight in the pub.

It's still the Deans vs the Burtons - only this time, it's Darlene who takes out what they are trying to do. Meanwhile, Lee and Robbie enlist the help of Bombhead, but the twins are onto them. Tony looks after Tom when Mandy is unable to. Liz later thanks Darlene for her help with the feud.
Dan grows increasingly depressed following Ellie's visit and Ben bigs Izzy to come home.

Johnno decides to go ahead with the yard sale, but Darlene can't help but poke her nose in. Tony wants to talk to Max about Mandy. Lee and Bombhead decide to stop trying to impress people when Lisa sees the funny side.
Ben finds life alone tough going, while Sally receives some shocking news.
The Hunters try to deal with earth-shattering news about Dan's welfare.

Ben refuses to look after Arthur. Scott wishes Natalie a happy birthday but she's a tad over amorous. Sally attempts to guilt-trip Ellie into telling the truth. But Ellie is adamant - what good would it do now? Nick is determined to find out who stole his poo.
Ellie continues to play dumb, and Ben squares off against Scott.
Johnno finds himself in a compromising position with his son's girlfriend.

Darren is still paranoid about the skimming scam. Ellie is still trying to make amends with Lisa, who's adamant that it's too late. Debbie is back at square one, with her confusion over Dan and Darren reaching an all-time high. Norman, Cameron, Steph and Zara head off to the crammer course for an intensive week of revision.

Lee has great difficulty concentrating on his revision. Mandy suggests the boys should "bond". Darren decides it's payback time and leaves Scott a little present on his computer. The kids wake up after spending their first night in Hollyoaks Comprehensive.

Cameron presents Norman, Steph and Zara with his wish list. Chloe tries to help Ben come to terms with his loss. Becca nervously arrives at the Deans' to spend the day with Jake. Lee is desperate to get some help with his revision, and Max tells O.B. a few home truths.

Becca swallows her pride and visits Jake at the Deans'. Darren makes a phone call he is sure to regret. O.B. pays Lee a visit to help him with his revision. Norman is excited at the prospect of doing exactly what he wants on his designated day. Richard breaks the news of the divorce to Ali and Darlene.

It's the last day inside the school before the kids have to go home. Scott gets a visit from the police. Craig makes Ali and Justin an offer they can't refuse. Mandy begins to feel sorry for Ellie as she knows how it feels to be the outcast.

An unwanted guest turns up at Gnosh Village. When a shocked Lee makes a disturbing discovery, the truth behind the real Toby Mills is at last exposed. Justin and Ali endure extra-tutoring. Darren begins to wonder if Scott is onto him or not.

The harsh truth hits home for Ellie. Richard and Liz surprise the children. Scott turns to Darren for support. Tony's stress levels rise to the max, but given what happened with the old lady yesterday, Tony might learn a lesson - what goes around comes around...

Darren continues to live on his nerves as the imminent threat of Scott's discovery threatens to take over his life. Tempers flare between Mandy and Tony when business continues to take a downward spiral. Craig talks to an upset Darlene and endeavours to get to the bottom of her tears.

Ellie visits Dan and is unnerved by his frosty reception. Tom is visiting Mandy and Tony looks forward to the teddy bears picnic he's organised. Becca carries on tutoring Ali and Justin, oblivious to the fact that she is the focus of a secret admirer. A tense Darren arrives at The Loft and is confronted by Scott...

The Loft is gutted after the fire as forensics sift through the debris. Events take a turn for the worse when Mrs Burton's engagement ring disappears over the Deans' fence and, in pursuit, she ends up at the bottom of a muddy pool. Bombhead is convinced Tony's misfortune is connected to the curse and remains resolute in his belief of the water exorcism.
Norman confronts Darren, who is concerned about Scott, and Ellie finds herself shunned by her family.
Dan gets ready for the bail hearing and Darren worries that Debbie is more interested in the jailbird than in him.
Dan takes his first steps in months as a free man.
Joe and OB put their new flatmates to the test. Tony discovers what Mandy's been up to.
Tempers fray between Darren and Norman.
Chloe is stunned when Max and OB ask if they can come on holiday with her.
The Hunters try to celebrate Dan's freedom, but they and Debbie remain miserable. Natalie and Craig help Ali plan Richard's stag do. Chloe is left angered by the disastrous camping trip.
Mrs. Burton goes shopping for a wedding dress with Sophie and Darlene.
Darren starts looking for trouble with Dan.
Debbie worries about the fight at the Dog.

Debbie tries to make amends with Darren, but Natalie puts a spanner in the works. Dan is increasingly frustrated with life on the outside. Lee, Lisa, Zara, Cameron and Abby prepare for the final stage of their school life. Ali is angry with his dad for missing his school prize-giving.
Ellie's story hits the press. Dannii gets a phone call from the college; she's in big trouble. Liz is flustered by the wedding preparations. Cameron is in serious trouble.

Dannii is distraught at the prospect of seeing the college principal. Mandy destroys her designs for the Taylor-Burton wedding. Norman is shocked when the police pay him a visit at The Dog in the Pond. Natalie's plan backfires as Darren and Mandy head upstairs...

Lee feels terrible; he'll never forgive himself if anything happens to Lisa. Mandy offers Tony a peace offering and he accepts; anything to salvage their relationship. Natalie is more than happy to tell Debbie about Mandy and Darren. Cameron is feeling guilty.

Cameron returns from the police station having confessed his crime. Tony puts on a brave face in the aftermath of the beating. Ben and Dan prepare for their skydiving trip. Ali is frustrated at being forced to help with the wedding.

Tony is stressed when Mandy suggests spending the day together. Sophie is in her element organising the Taylor-Burtons wedding, until she discovers her services are no longer required. Lee finally realises he loves Abby, but has he left it too late? Darren looks ahead to his date with Debbie but is irritated when his dad gives him a pep talk on how to treat a lady.

Darren offers to drive Debbie to the club and, while watching her on stage, sees her in a whole new light. Mandy's temper ignites as the situation begins to escalate dangerously out of control. The kids are adamant they're not attending Cameron's surprise party. Mischief is afoot when Mrs Burton's surprise 40th birthday banner is amended.

The atmosphere's tense between Mandy and Tony, and Becca is stuck in the middle. Craig has got the hots for Natalie, but can't bring himself to do anything about it. Lee tries to win back Abby's affections by turning himself into a modern man; he's convinced Abby won't be able to resist. Mr. Osborne gets the eye from some women at the bar and decides he's tired of being on the shelf...

It's Cameron's 18th, but it's far from a happy occasion; his friends aren't talking to him and his parents expect him to start acting responsibly! Debbie is invited for dinner at the Osbornes' and deliberately flirts with Mr. Osborne, who can't help ogling her.

Mandy is shocked to hear that Luke is getting married. Darren confesses his true feelings for Debbie and they enjoy a fun, passion-filled day together. Lee and Abby are desperate to get back together, but can't bring themselves to tell each other how they feel. It's Mrs Burton's birthday and Darlene is determined to give her one she'll never forget - by revealing her true age!

Natalie tells Darren he has to get over Debbie. Becca worries about Mandy behaving erratically. Natalie tells Craig they should keep their relationship secret for now. Liz is distraught that her real age has been discovered.

Craig tells Ali that he is in love with Natalie. Norman ribs Darren about his attempted snog with Natalie. Joe is convinced he needs to split up with Sophie. Tony makes a shocking discovery in Becca's toiletry bag.

Tony employs Jake's help to organise a knees-up for his and Mandy's engagement. Mr. Taylor and Mr. Dean get their glad rags on and hit The Dog in the Pond with the kids. Kristian's relentless barrage of negative vibes soon has the desired effect on Joe.

Mel makes a confession that reveals the true source of her woes. Mandy makes a revelation that shocks Becca. Can Dan convince Debbie that it's over for good? Lee spills the beans, leaving Lisa in hysterics and Mr. Hunter less than enthused about his son's prospects!

Debbie struggles to get over Dan. Mandy has had enough and doesn't pull any punches bursting Tony's bubble. Joe needs a miracle to get him out of this mess; could a charitable "sister" be the answer to his prayers? Lee gets kitted out in his uniform, but it's by no means what he had in mind!

Debbie is feeling sorry for herself after her disaster of a date with Darren, and Craig enlists the help of Becca. Richard pulls a muscle in his leg while coaching football. Darren shocks Max and O.B. when he says he's glad that the date with Debbie didn't go well.

Tony and Mandy reach a truce. Max and O.B. remain convinced both of them are in with a chance of being Chloe's 'sperm bandit'. Abby has reached the end of her tether, especially with Ben. Can they learn to compromise? Mel is dubious of Darlene's intentions to help organise Mrs. Burton's Hen Night after the last fiasco.

It's Mrs. Burton's Hen Night and Sophie's a little concerned by Darlene's overly friendly behaviour towards her. Tony wants to sort things out with Mandy and encourages her to face up to the past. Ben, Dan and Darren have a lads' night out at the SU Bar. Max and O.B. eagerly await Chloe's decision.

Tony is ashamed of his behaviour and can't face what he's done to Mandy. D.I. Davies and Dan are astounded when Ben reveals what he's done. Abby and Lee get cosy in the linen room, but get more than they bargained for, while Max is gunning for Tony when he sees the police with Mandy.

Mandy is undeterred and makes an announcement to a sea of shocked faces. Nick buys his round the world ticket and tries to convince Chloe to go with him. Bombhead seeks comfort in an old friend... Mr C! After an enjoyable day at the park, the Deans look forward to a brighter future.

Mandy's preparations for her wedding are well underway. Ellie prepares for her forthcoming court appearance. Mr. Taylor eventually spots the photo and it's Darlene who gets her eye wiped! Dannii is under pressure from her dad to attend the annual family holiday.

Business at Gnosh Village is on a downward spiral when a furious Max bounces in and confronts Tony. Ellie continues to pack up her belongings ready for storage in the Hunters' loft. Mrs. Burton is resolute that she can't marry Mr. Taylor. Dannii realises she may have bitten off more than she can chew.

Ellie appears in court. Tony's pitiful state leaves Becca thinking there is more to this than meets the eye. Will Nick follow his dream or fall into line with his folks? Dannii considers the dread of spending summer at home with her parents.

Ellie has a criminal record to live with for the rest of her life. It seems the students are doomed to fail but is Sophie about to have a change of heart? Despite Jake's constant suggestions, Becca is happy to stay at the flat while Mandy is away. O.B.'s words of wisdom put things in perspective for Nick.

A desperate Jake tries to keep Ben calm. How will Natalie respond when she learns of Craig's outrageous claims? Sally gives Les a shocking ultimatum. Dannii rallies the troops; late or not, they have merchandise that's worth flogging.

Nick makes up his mind, says his goodbyes and leaves to begin his new life. Ali is intrigued by a new arrival at Body Boost. Josh turns on Darlene - but she is saved at the last minute by a mysterious knight in shining armour. Tony contemplates a life without Mandy. Lisa tells Dan she is feeling guilty about moving out.

O.B. tries to convince Chloe to apply for the job at the radio station. Liam and Nicole contemplate their new life in Hollyoaks. Meanwhile, a besotted Darlene calls round to introduce herself to her hero from yesterday. Becca tries to get Tony to open up.

Becca tries to get Tony to open up. Tony is distraught and takes his frustrations out on Bombhead. Mrs. Hunter desperately wants rid of Ellie. Mrs. Burton has her dress fitting, but she's not too keen on Joe's design. Darlene makes Sophie wonder if she is over Joe.

Lee cracks under the strain and tells Dan how alone he feels. Natalie invites Craig over for a bit of fun. Steph finds Mrs. Burton rummaging in the rubbish bin hunting for her engagement ring. Ali continues his obsession with Nicole by calling round to see her.

It's the morning after the break-in at The Dog in the Pond. When Natalie issues an ultimatum, Craig has to swallow his pride. Mr. Osborne is delighted to see Ruth back in the village. Chloe has a job interview at a radio station in London. Liam is annoyed by people always fearing the worst from him.

Becca is shocked to find Ruth at the flat. Frankie and Debbie give Sally a day to remember. Russell and Liam sign up at HCC. Lee and Zara attempt to raise some cash for their trip to France. Lee tells Cameron that it's time he cut the apron strings.

Becca is still shell-shocked from seeing Mandy hit Tony. Les is in turmoil and desperately wants Sally back but Ellie is adamant that they can cope without her. Becca departs, leaving Justin with just the faint glimmer of hope that, perhaps, his love is not altogether unrequited.

Mandy is still unable to bond with her baby, and Dominic cautiously tries to find a way to broach the subject with Tony. Sam is eager for the next adventure with Andy, but the pair get their wires crossed. Craig is eager to talk to Darlene about their relationship, but finds that her mind is on other things.

It's Mandy's birthday, and Tony has bought her loads of presents - for the baby. Justin is getting advice from both sides of the law, fellow offender Dean in the Young Offenders' Institution, and his defence barrister. When the prison officer grabs him and takes him away, things look worse than ever for Justin.
Josh and Fletch pussy-foot around in the woods.
The boy Burton is under interrogation.
Max endeavours to offer his step-sister some solace.
A crucial witness takes the stand.
Justin awaits the final verdict.
Sam is distressed by Andy's nonchalence.
Jessica receives more obsessive correspondence.
Lee tries and fails to keep his empire under control.
There's clowning around in the SU Bar.
Louise thinks she knows what really happened to Dannii.
Cameron struggles to stomach the leftovers.
Bombhead meets his dad - and his new mum.
St Andrew's night prompts some unusual alliances.
Sam ruminates while Dannii riles.
Bombhead flies out of the Village.
Andy sweet-talks himself an ally.
Freddy tempts Zara with a bit of cyber crime.
OB and Craig believe they've hit on the perfect Christmas gift.
News of Nicole's conquest spreads.
Lee fights fire with fire - literally.
Sam receives a deputation of fearsome females.
Cameron surprises Steph with his musical prowess.
Sam answers a few questions.
Josh and Fletch are counselled in the ways of the world.
A new face joins the ranks of Chez Hutchinson.
Tony and Dominic indulge in some straight-talking.
The Ashworths struggle to appease their housebound relative.
You hum it, Cameron'll play it
Mandy is reconciled with her child.
Justin receives an unexpected Christmas present.
The Osbornes clean up after the night before.
Max and OB have a disagreement of business interests.
The brothers Hutchinson ruminate over much feud for thought.
A sort of homecoming for Liz, Mel and Sophie.
Mel chooses her own method of ringing out the old.
Mel suffers the morning after from hell.

eps.t: Laying It On With A Towel
eps.d: Sarah keeps a few things close to her chest.
There's a familiar face back at Hollyoaks Comprehensive.
Mandy checks up on Max and OB's progress.
Cameron opts for an unusual style of wallpaper.
Max takes a crash course in how to handle a woman.
Cameron reaches breaking point.
It's crunch time for Sam.
Max is desperate to keep Tom's mouth shut.
Justin wangles himself a job.
Justin gets his ears chewed off.
OB finds Max's behaviour hard to digest.
Steph demands Cameron be given the right to reply.
Max is thrust into a lycra-bound limelight.
There's plenty of holy disorder at the baptismal font.
Jessica receives an unwelcome visitor from the past.
Jake dispenses more potting shed pearls of wisdom.

Dannii bumps into Sam in the gym and tells him he's the only one who understands what she's had to go through - which makes him feel guiltier than ever. Gilly is dumbfounded to learn Mark has enrolled at the college, while Craig and Darlene spend the whole day together having fun.

Becca tries to encourage Justin to continue with his education, and Russ pleads with Dannii not to leave him, even suggesting they could run away together. Mel and Sophie work out at Body Boost and discuss their relationships with men, while Gilly faces the ordeal of his first philosophy class.
Becca gives Justin a bit of special out-of-hours tuition.

OB escorts Mel home after a drunken night out. When she invites him inside, she doesn't get the response she hoped for and slams the door in his face. Sarah receives a surprise deputation from her father.
Jake is excited at the prospect of trying for a baby but Becca is reluctant to make hay with her other half.
The Barnes family reel from some revelations.

Nancy and Nicole try to wind up Justin but he's got something else on his mind. Liz calls time on her family's presence in Hollyoaks but Darlene insists she'll be staying. Mandy meets up with Clare and Louise at the gym and struggles to keep up with them.
Hollyoaks Comprehensive cleaning staff gain a couple of new recruits, who prepare for Operation: Fit List.

Becca has to contend with yet more fatherly overtures, while Frankie reveals she knows the couple are trying for a baby. Mandy wins a luxury break but can she remember what happened to Thelma and Louise? Amy's dad quits his job.
Darlene looks for a new home whilst Liz plans for the future. Gilly starts his new job as a janitor at Hollyoaks Comprehensive.
Jessica makes a pact with her orange suitor.

Justin corners Becca, desperate to find out her true feelings. Mandy talks to Jake in an effort to confirm her suspicions about the pair. Russ and Sam are called back to the police station and fear their past could be about to catch up with them. Darren encourages Craig to stand up for himself.

Tony gets Mandy a truly surprising anniversary present. Sam calls at the Taylor-Burton house, desperate to confess everything to Sophie, but finds it hard to risk losing the woman he loves. Amy goes to the park with her friend Michaela, while Nicole receives a shocking blast from the past.

Nicole is surprised when she runs into Andy who later suggests they should get away from it all. Nicole agrees, unaware of Andy's evil plan. Mandy attempts to gets ready for her girlie holiday but everything seems to be going wrong.
Craig forgets it's Valentine's Day and has to make it up to Darlene. Steph and Cameron enjoy a Valentine's lunch at Il Gnosh. Josh and Fletch can't believe they made it on the Fit List.

Becca struggles with her feelings for Justin. Rhys is alarmed when he finds out Gilly is posing nude in his life class again. Fletch doesn't share Josh's confidence about the fit parade - they're going to need muscles but where are they going to get them from for tomorrow?

Jake prepares a romantic meal but Becca thinks he's only after one thing. Gilly is ecstatic when he finds out he's won tickets to the Manchester derby. Tony is bombarded with phone calls from Il Gnosh as he tries to relax at home. Meanwhile, Josh and Fletch continue with their plans to get fit quick.

Becca enjoys spending all morning with Justin but it doesn't last. Louise is surprised by the arrival of Sean, who she hasn't spoken to in two years. Jack doesn't think the lads are pulling their weight in Frankie's absence.

At the Osbornes', Darlene is still ruling the roost to Darren's dismay. Sean makes an appearance at the college to see Louise despite her not wanting to see him again - can he charm his way back? Sophie wants to know what's bothering Mel whilst OB is guilt-ridden over leaving Mel when she needed him the most. Michaela encourages Amy to go after Ste but is clueless on how to go about it.

Tony and Dominic fight for the Pit Stop and the Pharmacy at the auction. Craig informs Jack that if Darlene leaves then he will follow suit. Darren sets out to change Craig's mind and point out Darlene's flaws. Louise finds it difficult but manages to put Sean in his place. Meanwhile, Amy goes on her first date with Ste - will she get to first base?

Craig ignores Jack over his treatment of Darlene. Sean makes another appearance and Louise finds it difficult to keep her composure. Jessica panics over her Dear John letter and decides the only way out of this is to intercept Mark's post. Michaela lays the peer pressure on Amy so that Ste can take things further.

Liz decides to cut Darlene loose, leaving her to fend for herself. Russ and Nicole desperately want to tell their parents the truth but Sam insists that he'll do it... eventually. Carrie doesn't believe Sam was involved in the rapes. Jessica can't seem to locate the whereabouts of her letter to Mark - where could it be?

At the Owens', Nicole reveals Sam is a rapist but will his family turn him in if he won't? Craig shows no gratitude to Darren for bedding Darlene in his quest to reveal what a nasty piece of work she is. The thought of Jessica and Mark breaks Gilly's heart.

Rob attempts to help Sam run away to Estonia but Nicole and Carrie catch him on his way out. Sam begs to see Sophie one last time and to Nicole's dismay, Carrie agrees. Darren is confused as to why Craig isn't grateful for his selfless act of sleeping with Darlene. Craig has something up his sleeve and sets up a webcam in the flat.

How will Sam tell the truth about him and Andy when he visits Sophie? With there being reports of thefts in halls, Olivia still hasn't found her missing MP3 player. Craig plots against Darren who is busy getting ready for his date. Sarah prefers to spend time with Nancy but is distracted by her mum instead.

Sam prepares to run away with Sophie but his family catch on. Darren forgives Craig for what happened the day before thinking that's the end of it only for Craig to broadcast his webcam footage to the bar, revealing Darren's thoughts on the Welsh, women and students. Sarah trains at the pool again and her spirits are lifted when Rhys shows up which doesn't go unnoticed by her mum.

Unamused by Craig's revenge, Darren pushes Craig over the limit and is left to regret it. Things are awkward between Amy and Ste since she rejected his advances. Gilly maintains his double life as janitor/student but Louise is on to him as he tries to get to his seminar.

Jessica turns to Mark after being turned down by Gilly. However, Olivia hands Mark the missing letter that Jessica has been trying to track down. Tony keeps an eye on the builders as he tries to find out the plans for the Pitstop and the Pharmacy. His plan to get more information falls flat and he's left a laughing stock. Frankie returns home to find Craig and Darren squaring up to each other.

eps.t: Sean You Want To Do This?
Buxom Bad Boys Come to Blows
Would You Like a Bag With That?

eps.d: Joe takes the new students around town, attempting to get them drunk so he can convince them to let Olivia, Jessica, and him stay at the flat. Sophie and Mel try to deal with the fact that Evissa has sprung a leak. Nicole dreads going back to school, and someone in a grey sweatshirt is stalking Russ, Sophie, Mel, and Nicole.

Joe continues to try to convince the new students to let him stay in the flat, while Kris continues to clash with Jessica. Sophie and Mel spend some time together. Clare starts selling some iffy vodka at the Loft, and Justin and Sonny have a tension-filled run-in with Jake and Craig at the Union.

John Paul and Craig’s 1st meeting in the 6th form Common Room. John Paul observes Sonny bullying Craig, and later sets off the fire alarm when he sees Sonny and Justin follow Craig again as he didn’t think it was a fair fight.

John Paul studies alone in a classroom when Craig enters. After initial justification of their own behaviour, the pair start to bond over their need to get the grades to escape from their families and Hollyoaks and go off to lunch together.

Clare is left running scared after discovering the evidence that O.B., Mel and Sophie have against her. Craig, Steph and Darren are left running The Dog in the Pond after Jake, who was left in charge, ends up getting drunk. Olivia finally gains the courage to stand up to Jess, but all are left shocked when Sam bursts into the pub, armed with a petrol canister and lighter!

The customers in The Dog in the Pond are horrified when Sam bursts in holding a lighter, having doused the pub in petrol. As they struggle to find a way out, Calvin attempts to save Sophie from Sam's clutches by smashing a glass on his head, causing him to drop the lighter and the pub to explode. Sam is killed after being crushed by rubble, having been left to die by Russ.

The aftermath of the fire at The Dog affects everyone in Hollyoaks. Justin mourns the loss of his sisters, Russ feels guilt over his actions regarding Sophie, Zoe regrets not telling Joe she had feelings for him, and Kris doubts the sincerity of Jessica's grief over Olivia. Meanwhile, O.B. remains unconscious, and Clare searches for the proof he had that she cheated on her husband.

O.B. wakes up and is devastated to learn that Mel has died. Clare, meanwhile, tries to make sure that O.B. is unable to tell Max about her fling with Warren. Justin visits Louise to pack up his sisters' things to take with him on his trip to visit his mother. Sarah knows Amy is hiding something from her, but is ultimately distracted by discussions with Nancy about Rhys and Gilly.

Zak is assigned to Olivia's old room, and Jessica feels attacked by Kris, Zoe, Will, and Zak for their continued belief that she was not a good friend to Olivia. O.B. checks himself out of the hospital and stays with Tony while he still plans to expose Clare, not knowing that she has thrown out the evidence of her affair.

Russ moves into the McQueens – at least till Jacqui is home from prison. John Paul comes in and eyes the snowboard and skis, immediately bonding with another bloke in the house. Myra and the girls prepare a meal for Russ. Jacqui arrives home unexpectedly and thinks Russ is a burglar.

The McQueens prepare for Jacqui’s welcome home tea. Mercy is anxious over a deal she made with Jacq over the 300 quid shoes she nicked – if she can’t find them then Jacq gets to sleep with her boyfriend.. John Paul has nicked Michaela’s phone and is roped in to getting replacement shoes or Mercy will hell mum about the phone. Finishes with the presents and welcome home tea.

eps.t: Why Won't You Give Me Your Love?

eps.d: Sonny tells John Paul he is entering a DJ competition at the Loft and invites John Paul to go and see him. John Paul later meets Craig who supports John Paul entering the competition. Sonny cheats by using a CD. In the toilets John Paul asks Sonny to leave Craig alone as it’s his brother who is guilty.. John Paul wins the competition and is made resident DJ.

John Paul goes to see Claire to sort out his first gig at the Loft. As he goes to school he sees Sonny bullying Craig in the village; he asks Craig if he’s still up for the football tryouts with him. The pair go to get changed and Craig finds his mum put in odd socks including one pink sock triggering more bullying from Sonny.

Craig and Sonny wait with Frankie and Calvin to face the head over their debacle after the trials. They are both given a warning and Sonny refuses to shake hands and make peace. Craig decides he can’t handle Sonny and will leave school. When he has met John Paul, his mate questions why he’d return to school to just give up.
Carmel asks Jake out for a date. Sarah asks Amy to move in with her and Mike. Becca and Justin try to make up after their fight about Justin's using her credit card for the engagement ring.

Sonny jostles John Paul so he drops his records on the way in to the Loft. Sonny shows his annoyance that John Paul won, but John Paul stands his ground. Sonny takes over trying to act cool and knowledgable during the sound check – it seems Warren has offered him a second chance and he is told to return after JP has warmed up.

John Paul invites Craig to watch his set next week. The pair observe Justin’s return to school after Becca’s arrest. John Paul and Craig protect Nancy during a confrontation with Justin. They later observe the new Becca clone supply teacher. Justin leaves school.

Craig goes to watch John Paul in his DJing gig at the Loft, and joined by Sarah and Hannah. Craig makes a play for Sarah and both are trying to matchmake John Paul and Hannah who is far more interested in him than he is in her. Hannah invites her friends round to her house and is a bit full on with John Paul. Craig is desperate to ask Sarah out.

Craig tries unsuccessfully to persuade John Paul to ask out Hannah so they can arrange a double date so it’s easier to ask out Sarah. Sarah comes down to Drive n Buy for chocolate, and she suggests the two mates go to give her ideas for her essay on reconstructing a popular horror story. John Paul leaves Craig and Sarah as they are clearly getting on.

Justin and Sonny pick a fight with Craig, but John-Paul jumps in and scares them off. John-Paul trys again to tell Craig how he feels, but once again Craig doesn't realise and tells John-Paul he is his brother, and hero.
In an attempt to annoy Jessica, Kris tells Elliott to kiss Jessica. To make Kris jealous, she kisses him back. Kris is annoyed and gets his own back by making out with an other man.

Amy asks Josh if he can help her with her maths homework, but as a surprise for her Josh has arranged a family meal to show of his new girlfriend. Amy is not pleased and afterwards his mother threats to help everyone about her pregnancy unless she breaks it off with Josh. Amy then storms off leaving Josh confused and upset. Jake tries to bond with Charlie but Frankie keeps taking over.

Jake starts to bond with baby Charlie as he sneaks off before any one has woken, leaving Frankie in a panic. Steph tells Jake not to become to attached as the baby may not be his, after Justin threatens to fight him for the baby. Jake decides he must take a paternity test to find the truth. Amy and Josh get back together. Zoe goes on her date with Rhys only to be followed by Will.
There's a shock in store for Max as he finds Tom in the flat.
Looks like Tom's in trouble!
The police have a word with Clare... but who's in trouble?
Angry Rhys has words with Kris.
John Paul and Craig have a heart-to-heart. But what does John Paul say?
Sonny and Sasha catch Louise and Calvin in a compromising position.
Jake's behind the wheel again despite his driving ban.
Baby Charlie's safe in the back of Jake's car... or is he?
OB tries to persuade Clare to leave him, Tom and Max alone.
Tom looks petrified as Max and Clare confront each other.
Myra begs Carmel to patch things up with Calvin, but Carmel is still bitter towards her Mum and refuses, setting off for work instead. Meanwhile, Mark revels in all the bad feeling.
Calvin visits Warren to discuss Mark's relationship with Carmel and the raid on the Loft the previous day. Myra tells Jacqui to stop moping and get her life back on track.
Louise plans something special for her and Warren's wedding night and enlists the help of an unwilling Mandy to make things perfect. Carmel finds out about Mark being beaten up.

Beth concludes that someone has it in for her when she receives a Christmas card supposedly from her dead dad, before a brick is chucked through her window. Later, Rhys follows Beth home and they find themselves alone. After ripping into Darren following Jack's heart attack, Steph is shocked when Darren breaks down in tears, blaming himself for ruining everything.

Warren finds Darren miserable and drunk, and offers to let him buy his half of the pub back for £100,000. Niall accepts Myra's invite to spend Christmas dinner with the family and ends up stealing a family photo of the McQueens from Carmel's bedroom. While the Ashworths get festive, a burning newspaper is pushed through the door, and the Ashworths realise someone has a vendetta against them.
Myra begs Carmel to patch things up with Calvin, but Carmel is still bitter towards her Mum and refuses, setting off for work instead. Meanwhile, Mark revels in all the bad feeling.
Calvin visits Warren to discuss Mark's relationship with Carmel and the raid on the Loft the previous day. Myra tells Jacqui to stop moping and get her life back on track.
Louise plans something special for her and Warren's wedding night and enlists the help of an unwilling Mandy to make things perfect. Carmel finds out about Mark being beaten up.
Amy continues to avoid Leah and Lucas. Zoe is creeped out when Lydia wants her to move in. Dominic gets his revenge on Carmel.
Anita collapses after taking ecstasy at Dave's party. Cheryl get a job at The Dog in the Pond. Michaela and Jacqui decide to sell the leftover vegetables from the school cafeteria.
Anita accuses Dave of spiking her drink after he reveals that he isn't interested in her. Sasha interrupts Mercedes and Calvin. Zoe plans to play Lydia at her own game.

Dave is disappointed that nobody believes that he didn't spike Anita's drink. Jacqui continues to steal from the school and Des has no choice but to have her fired. Zoe decides to move in, so Amy decides to move out.

Dave is arrested for assaulting Ravi, and Anita is forced to admit that Dave never spiked her. Lydia becomes suspicious of Charlotte. Spencer tells Malachy that he saw Calvin and Mercedes kissing under the mistletoe.
Mercedes and Calvin enter in the "sexy santa contest" held by Cheryl. Dave is bitter towards Anita and Josh. Kris misreads the signals with Nancy.

Loretta is delighted when she opens up to Jake about her feelings and finds comfort. Des leaves Lauren thinking about Gaz. Duncan and Ricky set up a scam to fund their entry fee for a party at The Loft.

Rae is furious to discover that Newt also works at Relish. Duncan and Ricky panic when Myra ends up winning their fake raffle. Theresa is disappointed when she learns that Kathleen is arriving for Christmas. Loretta is overwhelmed when Jake gives her a locket.
Malachy is horrified to walk in on Mercedes and Calvin getting passionate. Loretta rejects Jake's offer to meet her parents. Kris makes things worse when trying to help Anita.

Malachy gets drunk after learning of Calvin and Mercedes's affair. Hannah remains adamant that she will remain living with Darren. Duncan and Ricky cover their tracks when they are faced with an angry Myra.

Anita reveals that she has heard Hannah vomiting in the bathroom. Mercedes wonders if Malachy has discovered her affair with Calvin. Ricky and Duncan are caught out, whilst Rae announces that she cannot work with Newt.

Everyone is worried as Hannah begins to behave erratically. Mercedes finds herself going back to Calvin even after the ordeal with Malachy. Tom is worried as to how Santa will deliver his presents, whilst Newt buys Rae a Christmas present, to her surprise.
Darren sends Hannah back home after discovering that she has relapsed. Theresa is disappointed when Kathleen fails to show. Gilly promises to help Steph.

Hannah struggles as her family worries about her. Cindy decides to create the perfect Christmas but nothing goes to plan. Jake is furious that everyone is happy for Darren to spend Christmas alone, so he reveals that Darren was the one who saved Holly.

Myra is disgusted when Kathleen arrives only to ask for the money from Theresa's father, but Kathleen decides to stay when she drives past Theresa at the bus stop. Hannah has decided to run away, and Darren decides to leave with her. Tom, Fernando and Steph all get along perfectly.

Hannah and Darren's life on the run is cut short when Hannah suffers a seizure and Darren decides that she needs to go back to hospital. Theresa is overjoyed when Kathleen is insistent on returning for good. Zoe's plan takes a step too far when Mike walks in on her kissing Lydia.

Frankie suspects that Gilly may have feelings for Steph. Zoe is deeply uncomfortable when Lydia wants to get Sarah's blessing. Suzanne struggles to figure out how to help Hannah when she turns on Darren.
Charlotte reveals the truth about Sarah's death to Mike. Zoe finds herself in a deadly situation when Lydia pulls a knife. Gilly is disappointed when Fernando plans to propose to Steph.

Zoe wakes up in hospital following her stabbing, and the news sends shockwaves through the village. Mike struggles to accept that his daughter was murdered, whilst Charlotte's friends turn against her after discovering her betrayal. Meanwhile, Gilly realises he must tell Steph how he really feels about her before Fernando proposes.

eps.t: 6 Reasons Why Not To Marry Gilly
eps.d: Gilly's situation is made worse when Cheryl announces their engagment to the rest of the village. When his attempt to end his relationship with Cheryl fails, Gilly hatches a plan to make Cheryl fall out of love with him. Meanwhile, Elliot is stressed as he revises for his final exams. But he soon becomes distracted by Lelia and her new job proposition from artist, Jack Welsh.

Darren feels responsible for Hannah's health problems and visits her in hospital, but he receives hostility from Rhys. Steph advises him to stay away, fearing he will do her more harm than good. When Darren finally gets to see Hannah, he is shocked by what she has to say to him.

Darren is unsure of what to do with Hannah and decides to leave her. Mercedes is left feeling guilty when Michaela fears that Zak will be unfaithful. Anita is filled with guilt and tries tough love to get through to Hannah. Fernando wants to buy a house in Spain, but Steph is unsure as to if she wants to go.
Cheryl is furious when Gilly accuses Rhys of having an affair with Cheryl. Zoe tries to fix Darren and Hannah. Anita and Ravi are shocked when Elliot reveals that Leila turned down the job for them.
Jason is taken to a gender disorder clinic by Heidi where he is introduced to Tamara. Seth is shocked when he finds out that Jason has been self-harming and he isn't sure who to tell.

Jason is taken by Carl to meet the headmaster. Eva decides to hand out a letter about Jason to the students. Ricky and Lee learn about Duncan's Wolf Boy stunt. Sinead confronts a stunned Amber about Rob being the father of her baby.
Jason gets ready for school and attempts to face up to the bullies there. Seth ends up getting into a fight with Bart which doesn't help matters.

Seth ends up starting to taunt Jason behind his back in an effort to fit in but he ends up taking things too far. Jason learns from Fern that she's going to plead guilty. Sinead is retrieve to the diary but Eva insists that she saw Amber and Rob kissing. Gabby tries to get Amber to think about Diane's offer.
Eva continues to cause trouble with the missing pages of Amber's diary. After she finds Rob at her house with Anita she calls the police.
Theresa ends up making a pact with Warren. Ethan ends up admitting to Kyle was attacked in prison and the trial has been postponed. Carl is furious when an article about Riley refers to Jason.

Jason is upset after hearing Heidi's malicious comments and ends up recording a video diary. Bart steals a car and takes Ruby joyriding in an effort to impress her but there is a disaster after Jason steps into the road. Ruby and Bart leave the scene and Jason is left fighting for his life.

As Jason lies in a hospital bed the truth about his self-harming comes to light and the doctors wonder if he stepped out in front of the car on purpose. Brendan discovers something interesting about Warren.

Brendan ia able to bluff his way to discovering to the truth about who killed and he has to decide what to do next. Theresa becomes more relaxed when Warren tells her Kyle has gone away. The big day arrives for Lee and Leanne.
Darren asks Nancy to marry him but their celebrations are cut short when they bump into Suzanne. Rae admits to Amy that she's pregnant and Amy goes to see Brendan.
The mess he finds himself in freaks out Darren. Mitzee decides to use her new knowledge to her advantage.
Mitzeee organises a photo shoot at Chez Chez. Brendan ends up helping her after a sleazy photographer crosses the line. Somebody is revealed as to be living in the Osborne's attic.
Ste is surprised by Brendan's new 'girlfriend'. Gaz threatens Anita.Theresa's secret looks like it could be revealed.
Gaz showing up makes Anita think about her future in Hollyoaks. Rhys is shocked that his mum is pregnant with Darren's twins.

Look Sharpe has it's grand opening. After Suzanne Ashworth's waters break she ends up having to give birth in the spa. Mitzeee ,manages to steal Guy's thunder with a revealing publicity stunt. Things heat up between Mercedes and Carl.
Darren attempts to adjust to his new role as a father. Heidi's father Silas returns to stay with the Costellos.

The intruder at the Osbourne house wakes up and wants to speak with Jack and Frankie. Carl attempts to turn Riley's attentions away from Mercedes. There is tension for Nancy as Darren and Suzanne drive her to distraction with different possible baby names.
Esther ends up revealing some shocking news about Frankie's past. Silas is not happy when Heidi's mum's ring goes missing.
Warren is not happy after he receives a lot of threatening texts. Carl blames Mercedes for Heidi's accident. Esther ends up resorting to blackmail after Jack and Gilly ask her to leave.
Mercedes is surprised with a romantic proposal from Riley much to Carl's dismay. Frankie is worried after Tom doesn't show up at school.
Texas finds it hard to cope with the thought of attending India's funeral and ends up begging Doug to provide her with drugs. Warren is happy after finding Brendan's secret stash.

Brendan is furious when Brendan informs him that he has disposed of the drugs stash. Heidi and Myra set about planning the wedding of the year. Texas continues along the road of self-destructive path after waking up next to Doug.

Jamil and Doug are concerned after Tex goes missing before the funeral. Warren throws a drugged up Tex out of the club. The McQueens and Costellos come to a head while arranging the wedding. Rae informs Ste that she has decided to keep the baby.
It looks like the killer has had a change of heart when he takes the comatose Texas to hospital. Ste doesn't know what to think about the arrangement between Rae and Brendan.

Heidi feels insecure following the accident and ends up being comforted by a smitten Gaz. Rae comes to a decision about her and Ste's future. Ruby and Ricky skive off school and Esther is able to convince them to take her along.
Gossip spreads that Kyle Rider is back in town which prompts Theresa to panic that he has come to take revenge. Rae at risk of losing her baby due to Brendan's threats.
The rest of the family advise Theresa to escape from the village with her baby. Lynsey and Gilly agree to slow things down. Rae learns that she is at risk of losing her unborn child.
Warren sees Brendan as he meets with Kyle. Ethan attempts to persuade Theresa not to leave town.
Warren attempts to rescue Theresa and her baby but Kyle gets in his way. Carmel and Ethan end up saving the day.
Following Kyle's attack, an ambulance is called and those that have been wounded are rushed to hospital as the paramedics fight to save their lives.
The consequences of Kyle's revenge attack begin to be felt. Jacqui thinks about giving Rhys a taste of his own medicine after discovering that he has cheated on her.
Jacqui attempts to sneak out of Gilly's bedroom without being seen but she ends up running into Rhys. Ricky tries unsuccessfully to woo Ruby.
Carmel's spirit visitor makes another visit during her date with William. Duncan feels embarrassed after finding out that Esther is a lesbian after he tries to woo her.
Ste spends some time with Noah in the hot tub and a jealous Brendan spots them together. Doug ends up getting himself into trouble. Warren visits Ethan.

The McQueen's become defensive when Riley begins asking questions about Theresa. Ethan ends up lying for Theresa to get Riley off her back. Doug is confronted by Noah about the pills and warns him to get rid of them. Police officers show up to arrest Gilly.

Ste learns that Brendan was to blame for Noah losing his job at Look Sharpe. Gilly finds the going tough as news about his night of passion with Jacqui breaks. Tom finds himself forced to move back in with the Osbornes.
It looks like Leanne has an ulterior motive when she agrees to become part of a money-making scheme with Lee. Brendan's passion for Ste ends up turning to violence again.
Amy gets the chance to try out as a teaching assistant at Hollyoaks High and she discovers that her new boss, Pete is an old friend of Brendan's. Pete threatens Brendon to leave Ste alone.
Pete takes Amy out for a drink and she ends up questioning him about his history with Brendan. Jason and Seth throw a joint birthday party. Seth ends up getting kissed by an unlikely girlfriend.
Warren notices Brendan's awkwardness around Pete and he wonders if it was Brendan who caused Pete to end up in the wheelchair. Seth is offered some dodgy steroids.
Rhys is urged to make a choice. Duncan spreads gossip about Gaz. Pete is determined to reveal Brendan's true colours.
Seth is in hospital following his collapse and Jason tries to get Gaz to come clean about the steroids. Brendan is not happy at becoming the subject of village gossip.
Heidi and Gaz get passionate as Seth recovers in hospital. Mitzeee is determined to find out more about Pete even though she thinks he is gay. Ste and Pete are messing around which annoys Brendan.
Rae ends up agreeing to help Doug shift some drugs but she ends up being set up by Brendan. Noah, Ethan, Jamil, Doug all vie to get a ticket to a VIP event that Riley has tickets too.
Rae is released by the police and Brendan is furious at being double-crossed. Whilst Diane is away, Sinead decides to throw a party.
The McQueen family are surprised following the revelation about William. Seth finds himself facing rejection at Sinead's house party. Rae decides to leave town for a while to avoid anymore trouble.

The McQueen family find themselves forced to deal with another revelation when Kathleen explains she too has a secret she needs to reveal. Noah tries to sort things out with Liberty after she falls victim to one of his pranks.
