Silas warns Lynsey that he's planning something very dark for Halloween. Mercedes receives some shocking news. Ste ends up agreeing to allow Amy take the kids to New York, but after Lee sees how crushed Ste is, he wonders if he can really go through with it.

Lynsey is set by Silas a terrifying challenge which sees her being forced to identify his next intended victim before midnight on Halloween. If she succeeds, he claims he will hand himself over to the police, but if she fails another girl will lose her life.

Mercedes remains captive up in Silas's vault. Lynsey tells Doug about the deadly game she is being made to play. Theresa and Will finsd it hard to enjoy a romantic evening alone. Amy attempts to deal with the fact that Lee has given up on his dream.

Lynsey is concerned that Theresa or Texas could be Silas's next target after she receives a cryptic clue. Rob and Annalise's reconciliation once again ruins Theresa and Will's efforts to spend time alone together.
A desperate Lynsey attempts to work out who the next victim will be before it is too late. Will and Theresa finally enjoy an evening alone together.

Chez Chez hosts Fright Night and most of the residents of Hollyoaks have gathered to celebrate in fancy dress. Nobody believes Lynsey's claims of what's is going to happen. Texas finds out about the bet between Scott and Dodger and gets even with them.

Fright Night continues at Chez Chez with Dodger attemting to charm Texas into returning to the party. Bart watches from the sidelines as Gaz and Sinead have fun together and becomes even more jealous. Cheryl leaves early.

Hollyoaks' residents are shocked to find out that the serial killer has struck again. Riley starts to question his grandfather's innocence. Cheryl finds some comfort with Gilly. Silas's deadly games continue.

The village grieves following everything that has happened but the spate of tragedies is not over for the McQueen family. Maddie ends up finding herself in a compromising position after Gaz reveals he prefers her to Sinead.

The McQueen family are determined to see justice being done. Gilly turns to Frankie for advise about his growing relationship with Cheryl. Duncan makes plans to take his relationship with Kelly to the next stage.
The McQueen family rally around as Silas plans his last move. Sinead has some difficult questions for Gaz.

The sixth form students attempt to bring the village together as they pay tribute to the serial killer's latest couple of victims. Brendan is determined to get even with Warren. Bart thinks about telling Sinead how he really feels.

Bart tries to warn Sinead to end her relationship with Gaz. Rob ends up panicking after he realises that Annalise expects him to celebrate their two-year anniversary instead of partying with Ash. Duncan enjoys his romance with Kelly.

Sinead sees a job advert needing someone to come on tour to sell gig merchandise. Sinead want the job for her and her boyfriend. Gaz shows up to dump Sinead, but hears the man agreeing to give him the job.

Sinead informs the sixth-formers and the she is leaving because she and Gaz are working at a gig tonight and then going on tour. Maddie has a chance to warn Sinead about Gaz but decides not to as she wants Sinead gone. Bart ends up telling Sinead.

Bart attempts to get into the gig to find Sinead. Tilly urges Maddie to stop Sinead making a huge mistake. Gaz sees Bart and has him thrown out. Bart ends up making one last-ditch attempt to win Sinead back.
After Ethan returns to the village, he ends up feeling more isolated than ever. As he attempts to find some reassurance it ends up leaving new guy Rob's life in jeopardy after he texts while driving.
Ethan ends up turning to Theresa for help. A new Savage family member shows up in the form of Dodger and Will's cousin, Dennis.
Time is starting to run out for Ethan when Theresa finally sees his true colours and refuses to keep his secret.
Rob desperately tries to remember what happened on the night of the accident, while Dodger's womanising ways finally catch up with him.
Annalise struggles with her feelings for Scott and the part she played in Rob's accident. Warren enjoys making Ethan squirm. Michaela's first rehearsal with the band doesn't go too well.
A confused Gilly turns up at Rhys and Jacqui's flat. In a tense, emotional real-time episode, these three characters - bound together by events of the past - try to make sense of it all.
Mitzeee is avoiding Warren, while sparks fly as feisty Maddie takes on enigmatic Callum for a debate at college.
Maddie, Tilly and Sinead enjoy a great night out. Maddie attempts to make Callum jealous when she flirts with DJ Joel. The evening ends up finishing in disaster.
An upset Maddie is rescued by Callum. The unlikely couple attempt to get beyond their spikey banter.
Brendan is still AWOL after being let out of prison, which fuels Warren's paranoia. New boy Joel is curious to get the low-down on Warren.
Mercedes attempts to make Riley spend time with her and the baby but things don't go to plans after he announces that he wants to know the truth with a paternity test.
Warren finds it hard to deal with terms with Joel's presence in the village. Theresa attempts to convince him to find out exactly who Joel is.
Joel ends up freaking out after he sees another side to Warren that he doesn't like. Warren is concerned that he may have made a costly mistake.
Mercedes waits to discover who the father of her child is and hopes she will get the answer she is looking for.
Mercedes has to deal with the results of the paternity test. Ash attempts to work out exactly what's going on between Scott and Annalise.
After Brendan attempts to get his claws into Joel, Warren is furious. Sparks start to flow between Theresa and Joel.

Ethan is pressured by Warren to give him with an alibi so that he can get rid of Brendan for good. Louis, Danny and Laurence are warned off Ruby by Jack. Ruby ends up taking a huge risk to try and win Sinead's favour.
After Jack finds out that he's missing some money, Ruby's in trouble. Warren is confronted by Theresa about Ethan's confession.
Callum attempts to get Maddie to learn more about him as they enjoy their proper date. Mitzeee finds out that Warren has been lying to her about Ethan. Nancy issues Mitzeee with a warning.
Nancy is left reeling after she gets a warning visit from Brendan. Mitzeee ends up coming to the conclusion that there is no escaping Warren. Brendan ends up coming up with a shocking solution.

Tara's return ends up causing trouble for Callum and Maddie's relationship after Tara refuses to give up on Callum. Warren's efforts to try and keep Mitzeee on side leave her feeling more scared than ever.
Maddie ends up having a go at Callum which could see him ending up back in Tash's arms. Dennis attempts to impress Leanne, but she has her sights on somebody else.
Maddie begins to self-destruct as she tries to get rid of her feelings for Callum. Leanne has no clue about Dennis' true feelings after she asks him to help her ensnare Matt.
George's efforts to get Maddie and Callum back together end up failing when Maddie starts to isolate herself from the group. Ash's meddling ends up making Callum give Tara an ultimatum.
Mitzeee returns following a trip with Warren. Leanne's efforts to try and make make Matt jealous end up leaving pleasing Dennis.
Brendan and Mitzeee continue with their plot against Warren. Mercedes attempts to convince Seth to talk about Riley.

Doug and new student Jodie go out on a date but sparks end up flying after she meets Dodger. Riley is surprised to learn that Mercedes has left baby Bobby at home with Bart. Joel becomes suspicious about Mitzeee after he catches her crying to Brendan.
Brendan and Warren end up fighting when Nancy finds it hard to contain a shocking revelation. Mitzeee attempts to win Warren over. Riley and Mercedes plan a Christmas meal for Bobby.

Mercedes finds it hard to create the perfect Christmas meal with Riley and calls for back-up from the rest of her family. Cracks begin to form in Mitzeee and Brendan's plans which end up having deadly consequences.

Things end up coming to a dramatic conclusion on Christmas Eve when Warren takes Mitzeee to the place where he buried Louise's body. Brendan finds himself in a race against time to find them before history repeats itself.

In a special It's A Wonderful Life homage episode, as Doug finds himself on a bridge at his lowest, and after jumping into the river he gets a visit from the much loved and missed Stephanie Del A Dean who shows him what life in the village would've been like had Doug never been there. He's then left with a choice to either join his girlfriend Bec's in heaven or to return to his life.
Texas and Jodie deal with the fallout from the previous day's events. As Joel is left wondering if he has any place in Hollyoaks. And, Mercedes questions whether she can bring up Bobby on her own.

The students prepare to travel to Barney's, but Theresa and Will feel further apart than ever. Meanwhile, Mercedes is gutted when Riley snubs her, but he soon regrets it when she stops him from seeing his son.

The students are in high spirits, intending to enjoy their impressive surroundings, but an unexpected arrival threatens to spoil the party. Meanwhile, Jacqui tells Mercedes to move on and put the past behind her, leading her to do something drastic. The ongoing love-games between Jodie, Doug and Dodger continues.
Mercedes finally prepares to let go of Riley, but when she realises just how much this will cost her, she's not sure whether she can bring herself to go through with it.
Will Sam, Matt, Danny, Laurence and Louis actually move to London when a hot offer comes their way from an A&R guy who is interested in the band?
Cindy gets her comeuppance when the bailiffs show up to seize her assets, but will the McQueens let her get away without paying Carmel for all her hard work?
Banged up together in a cell, Jacqui, Carmel, Myra, Lynsey, Cheryl and Nancy blame Cindy. Bart kicks off at a miffed Sinead.
As Ruby eagerly anticipates her 16th birthday, Cheryl makes an announcement about her new direction in life. At her lowest ebb, Cindy gets an offer of help from ex-husband Tony.
Ruby is desperate to interest the cool sixth form gang in coming to her 16th birthday party. A very hungover Cheryl, Lynsey, Jacqui and Nancy wonder exactly what they did last night.
Declan's arrival in the village poses some questions for all concerned, while Ruby's 16th birthday party is a disaster.
Cheryl and Lynsey worry about Declan, while Jono struggles to avoid Ruby's attentions. Dennis cooks a romantic meal for Leanne, but isn't prepared for her reaction.
Cheryl grows concerned when Declan begins portraying Brendan-like traits at the pub quiz. Ruby finally finds the courage to ask Jono on a date, while Dennis changes tack with Leanne.
Callum's determination to help improve George's self-confidence doesn't have the desired effect, while Jono and Ruby enjoy their first date.
Bart nervously awaits his dad's arrival, while Callum learns the truth about George. And Ruby invites Jono to the empty flat.
Maddie returns from holiday while Jono is on cloud nine after sleeping with Ruby - but is she simply using him to climb the social ladder? Dennis faces a difficult choice between Mumbai and Leanne.
George, Phoebe and Callum come to blows. Ruby is left confused about where she stands with Jono, and Dennis gets the wrong end of the stick when Leanne tries to let him down gently.
It's getting harder for Callum to keep George's secret to himself. Leanne is heavy-handed when she clears the air with Dennis, while Jono and Ruby are unaware that they are falling in love.
Ruby's getting mixed messages from Jono, who's feeling self-conscious about his lack of experience, while Callum's loyalty to George is affecting his relationship with Maddie.
Maddie uses Sinead to drive a wedge between Jono and Ruby. And Darren, convinced he knows everything about Nancy, starts arrangements for a secret wedding.
Things get awkward for Mercedes at the hospital when a doctor recognises her as someone he had relations with. And Cindy helps Darren with the secret wedding plans.
Doctor Browning pays Mercedes to go out with him again. Lynsey crosses the line at the hospital when she interferes with a patient's medication. And Neil has to learn how to drive.
Lynsey applies for her old nurse's job, but potentially ruins her chances. Cindy tries to sabotage Darren's plans. And Cheryl realises her night with the students got quite out of hand.
Darren appears to slip back into old, destructive ways when he uses Jack's wedding gift at the casino. Mercedes tries a spot of blackmail, while Neil needs to take his driving lessons seriously.
Mercedes starts blackmailing Dr Browning - could this be what Lynsey needs to get her old job back?
Ruby feels alienated from the group and is afraid to approach Jono. Jacqui and Rhys' money worries grow so they look for a lodger to help ease their finances.
Ruby makes up with Jono and they sleep together again, but are his motives true? Jacqui and Rhys get a hot new lodger called Ally to help with their mounting money problems.
Phoebe is suspicious of a friendly stranger. Ally moves into Rhys and Jacqui's flat and there's immediate friction between Amy and Ste, who both fancy Ally.
Phoebe starts to put two and two together regarding Deena's hospitality and realises she and George are in a very dangerous situation.
Seriously worried for Phoebe's safety, George rings Callum for help. A desperate search for her begins. But are they putting themselves in further danger by looking for her?
Nancy's mum makes a surprise visit to Hollyoaks and drops a bombshell that sends Darren's wedding plans reeling.
Margaret sets about breaking Nancy and Darren up - but is her poison enough to make Nancy reassess her future in the village?
Cindy makes a move on Darren while Nancy's suspicions escalate when she finds an incriminating piece of evidence in Darren's pocket. Disaster strikes when Neil drives the sixth formers.
Reeling from their kiss, Darren desperately tries to find Cindy before she blows his secret, while Nancy's fears are confirmed when she catches Darren and Cindy in a compromising embrace.
Will the sixth formers forgive Neil after the crash when he explains why he felt the need to impress them? Ruby confronts Jono when she finds out the reason for his secrecy.
Darren is putting the final touches on his surprise Valentine's Day nuptials with Nancy. Lynsey turns detective and is horrified to discover who Mercedes has gone to meet.
Everyone is making final preparations for the wedding when the Osbornes make the shocking discovery that Nancy has disappeared.
Nancy is shocked to discover she is supposed to be getting married today. Will she forgive Darren for his deception in time to make it down the aisle?
Mitzeee struggles to understand why Joel has returned to the village, while Brendan gets an unpleasant surprise when he uncovers the reason behind it.
Dodger's plans for some brotherly bonding go awry when Will has a run-in with Joel.
Brendan is determined to find a way to oust Joel, but Mitzeee warns him not to do anything too drastic.
Joel's attempts to woo Theresa backfire when his jealousy gets the better of him and Theresa witnesses his darker side.

Mercedes is unapologetic for her actions last night, but Theresa is determined to give Mercedes another chance and suggests she could look after Kathleen Angel for a while. However, when Theresa returns to an empty house, she panics - where the hell is Mercedes?!

A frustrated Mercedes tries her best to make amends, but things go from bad to worse when the McQueens end up in A&E. As Mercedes spirals further out of control, Jacqui decides that they have to do something - and soon!
Jacqui pays a visit to a face from the past, determined to do what she can to help Mercedes. But while she's away, Rhys is shocked when Mercedes hits a new low. Is it too late to help her?
Rhys reels in horror from Mercedes's kiss. Mercedes begs Rhys not to say a word, but will he or won't he tell Jacqui?

Blood-thirsty Jacqui arrives at the McQueens to take Mercedes to task for snogging Rhys. Jacqui, Carmel and Myra tear a strip off home-wrecker Mercy and for once mild-mannered Carmel truly lets rip. It looks as if it's all over for the McQueens, until Mercy reveals a dreadful secret.
A hungover Texas wakes in bed with Jodie and wonders what the hell happened last night. Myra lays down the law with Mercedes: fix things with Jacqui or you're out of the family.
Mitzeee tries to persuade Mercedes to get out of Riley's life, but Mercy begs Riley to take her back. Is that what he's come back for?
Jacqui is suspicious over Mercedes' motives for wanting Riley back. Dodger discovers that Texas snogged Jodie and is surprised by his jealous response. But who is it he's most jealous of?
Darren privately worries about Riley's threat to sell the pub and is sent reeling when Nancy drops a bombshell of her own.
George's elation at being reunited with Phoebe doesn't last long when she leads him into the hands of Deena. Riley agrees to let Myra see Bobby so long as she doesn't tell Mercedes.
Worried about George's disappearance, Callum tells Maddie the truth about his living situation - will she forgive the betrayal?
The sixth formers struggle to digest the news that George is homeless. When their search for him proves fruitless, Maddie takes drastic action.
Tensions surface among the sixth formers as they wait for news of George. A romantic evening for Annalise and Rob ends in heartbreak when Annalise struggles to ignore Scott's harsh words.
A terrified George is desperate to escape from Deena and Graham's clutches. How far will the evil pair go to make George and Phoebe do what they want?
Without Phoebe's help, George faces the darkest moment of his life. Is there any way to escape from Deena and Graham?
Tensions are high at the business competition. Do Ste and Doug stand a chance after winding Tony up? Annalise is quietly confident, but will her desire for perfection prove her undoing?
On a drinking session with the rugby team, Rob is determined to prove he's over Annalise. But will his efforts cause a rift with new team-mate Will?
When Rob crosses a line, the appalled Sixth formers have to act. But will he admit what's really going on? And Mitzeee tries to help Riley's custody case by stirring things up.
Myra begs Riley to invite Mercedes to the christening, but he is set on continuing his game playing. Dennis returns from India, but Leanne is convinced there's something he's not sharing.
Mercedes can't forgive her family for their betrayal, while Riley prepares for the mediation session with her, worried that he's pushed her too far. Barney is forced to face his attacker.
Jacqui surprises Rhys when she invites Phoebe to stay the night.

It is chaotic as everyone prepares for Bobby's christening, but the McQueens panic when they realize Mercedes and Bobby are missing. Following her discovery, Mercedes is ready to kill and Mitzeee is at the centre of Mercedes' scorn. And Jacqui and Rhys are fuming when they realise the cost of their kindness.
Riley is worried about what Mercedes will do and is thrown when she is so calm, but he's unaware that this is really the calm before the storm.
When Jacqui finds Phoebe begging with her stolen dog, all hell breaks loose. It's awkward between Annalise and Rob in the student halls, while George announces he's leaving Hollyoaks for good.
There's fallout in the student halls as the students figure out who Annalise brought home. In the heat of the argument, Ash collapses and her condition looks serious. And Nancy is in terrible pain.
Jacqui takes Phoebe to work with her at The Dog so that Phoebe can pay Jacqui back what she owes her. As meningitis-struck Ash fights for her life, Lacey is convinced she's to blame.
When Martha hits the bottle, Callum is forced to tell George the truth about her drink problem. Jacqui discovers her wedding ring is missing. But is Phoebe to blame?
Will keeps vigil at Ash's bedside, praying for her to wake up, while the awkwardness continues between Mitzeee and Riley - will they own up to their feelings?
Doug is floored when Ste walks out on their fledgling business. Joel's desire to impress Brendan backfires. Texas and Jodie decide to give their relationship a go.
Doug and Ste's meeting at the bank leaves them deflated. Sensing an opportunity to gain a hold over Ste again, Brendan makes Doug a tempting offer.
Doug runs out of options when trying to raise money for the deli - but will he let Ste down or take Brendan up on his offer? Texas is forced to choose between Jodie and Dodger.
Mitzeee's plans for Riley's surprise birthday party take shape, but will Mercedes scupper them? Meanwhle, Riley and Lynsey spend the day together at the gym.
Tony goes head-to-head with Doug and Ste as the winning bidder for the deli is revealed, but can Doug go through with his deal with Brendan?
There's friction between Mitzeee and Riley when she exaggerates the attentions of a fan to a journalist - is she willing to sacrifice her family for fame?
With Joel in danger, will he remain loyal to Brendan, despite the risk, or sell him out to save his own skin? Elsewhere, Barney is thrilled to be introduced to Scott's world in London.
Can Maddie finally admit to Callum her fears about their physical relationship? Mitzeee sacrifices her celebrity interview to keep the peace with Riley.
Maddie's insecurities reach fever pitch when Callum leaves her after they sleep together for the first time. Mitzeee is freaked out when she receives another creepy gift from her super fan.
Tilly is thrilled her art event at College Coffee is a success, but when intriguing art fan Jen arrives sparks fly. Could this be a fatal attraction?
Jacqui reluctantly goes to the McQueens' for dinner when Myra insists Mercy is out. However, it's not long before talk turns to her feud with Mercy and they're back to square one.
Desperate to win favour with George, Phoebe hatches a plan. Tilly's efforts to keep the truth from Jen leave her in a dangerous situation.
Jacqui is determined to help Phoebe, but Rhys is less than enamored when he realises exactly what she has in mind.
George washes his hands of Phoebe, while Jacqui is determined to help her. However, Rhys is less than enamoured when he realises exactly what she has in mind.

Rhys makes Phoebe less than welcome when she moves into her new home, and enlists the aid of the other McQueens to talk some sense into Jacqui. However, the plan is derailed when Mercedes turns up, and the feuding sisters end up coming to blows again.
Phoebe’s mum Mel turns up unannounced at Jacqui & Rhys’ determined to get her daughter back, while Mercy gives Phoebe money to buy Jacqui something nice… But what’s she up to?
Phoebe runs away, giving Mercedes and Jacqui a chance to make amends as they try to track her down.

Rhys is shocked at Phoebe's revelation that her mum is a prostitute. Mercy and Jacqui have realised the same thing and Jac is at loggerheads over Phoebe living with Mel. Will they all reach an agreement over what to do with Phoebe?
Bart and Joel's club night couldn't be going any better - until Maddie ruins everything.
Ruby's social status hangs in the balance as Jack makes her pay for her night out.
Bart awaits a delivery from Joel, Scott's return puts pressure on Annalise to tell Rob about their romance and a package from her stalker leaves Mitzeee more paranoid than ever.
Sinead discovers Bart's job for Joel, Annalise worries that Scott won't want to be with her and Mitzeee eagerly prepares for her television debut. But the stalker is never far away.
Mitzeee loses it live on air after more harassment. It is only a matter of time before Rob discovers Annalise and Scott's duplicity, and Bart comes up with a quick money-making fix.
Mitzeee's trauma continues as the harassment escalates. Wardy warns Scott to stay away from Annalise and Bart's money-making scheme goes awry.
The stalker's escalating antics force Mitzeee to come clean. Elsewhere, the book club takes an unexpected turn, and Doug finds himself jealous of Ste's date.

It’s the opening day of Ste and Doug’s deli. To celebrate, Doug heads to the pub, but a few drinks lead to something more with Texas as his determination to play it straight continues. Still terrified of her stalker, Mitzeee is unsure whether she can handle a public appearance. However, Mercedes gives her just the push she needs to get back out there.

Texas and Doug agree that their night together was a drunken mistake. However, when they go for a drink to talk, things go from bad to worse for Doug. Could this have something to do with Ste? A furious Riley confronts Mitzeee about her lies, so when she gets an offer of work abroad, it seems like the perfect solution for them both.

Doug and Ste’s professional relationship is put under strain when their personal lives get in the way. Later, Doug finally cracks and confesses his love. It’s the college open day and queen bee Maddie is in her element showing the newbies around, but she’s disturbed to find Ruby a potential threat to her status.
Doug has a change of heart after Ste's new man Adam shows up. Esther tries to assuage her guilt by stopping the rumours about Tilly, and Cindy's birthday meal for Tony is a big surprise.
Doug and Ste's fight turns to passion, Brendan finds an unwelcome visitor at the club, and Ruby must choose Esther or Maddie. Cheryl and Cindy go to war over a handsome new arrival.
Brendan is thrown by Walker's presence in the village and reluctantly agrees to give him a place to crash for a couple of days. Michaela is excited by an offer to go and see some old faces.
Brendan is furious when he uncovers Walker's real intentions, and after Amy hides Dodger from Ally, their friendship falls apart. Will Dennis surprise the girls on their road trip?
Brendan's plan to teach Walker a lesson puts Joel in grave danger, and when the truth about Amy and Dodger comes out, Ally is devastated. Michaela is surprised by Josh Ashworth.

While Joel fights for his life, Brendan is hell bent on revenge. However, when Cheryl overhears a conversation between Brendan and Walker, she insists that there's only one person responsible - Brendan. Meanwhile, a heart-to-heart between Dennis and Dodger prompts Dodger to reach out to Texas, but will it be enough? Elsewhere, an old friend helps Amy realise she has to take a few risks.
Can Brendan convince Cheryl of his innocence? Amy makes a desperate plea to Ally, and Dodger waits to see if Texas will respond to his request.

The McQueens aren't letting Myra's court date get them down - it's party time for the family with Michaela's 21st and the Diamond Jubilee celebrations. Lynsey and Riley are also at the party and they struggle with how to tell Mercedes about their relationship.

A jealous Brendan can't handle Ste and Doug's relationship, but before he can do anything, Doug comes clean to Ste about the money behind the deli. Meanwhile, Mercedes struggles with the news of Lynsey's betrayal, but can she find it in herself to forgive her friend? Elsewhere, with Jacqui taking control at the McQueens', Liberty finds herself homeless like Dirk and Dodger.

Manipulative Brendan presents Ste with a promising business proposal, but is that all he wants from his former flame? Meanwhile, Texas and Leanne help Doug find a way to win back Ste, but is he too late? Elsewhere, testosterone is flying high in the Savage household.

Joel is seething when he discovers that Walker is back and wants to know exactly what Brendan is up to. Meanwhile, spurred on by Mercedes, a jealous Lynsey challenges Riley over his feelings towards Mitzeee. Desperate to prove his love for Lynsey, Riley suggests they should take their relationship to the next level. Elsewhere, Dennis is gutted to discover that the Savages have left.

Ste finally declares his love for Brendan, as long as he wipes out the deli's debt. Doug is devastated and makes a rash decision. Meanwhile, with no headliner, Will is forced to face the baying crowds at his party - but will a shock arrival save the day? Elsewhere at the event, Dodger is rocked to the core when he discovers a shocking family secret.

Cheryl is unnerved when she sees an old face return to the village and fears that Brendan may be up to no good. Meanwhile, the Savages are in a celebratory mood after their festival success, but their high spirits are crushed when they discover that their profits have been stolen. Barney is horrified when the finger of suspicion points at him, but can he prove his innocence?
Ste finally declares his love for Brendan, as long as he wipes out the deli's debt. Doug is devastated. And with no headliner, Will is forced to face the baying crowds at his party.

Lynsey and Riley host the dinner party from hell and no matter how much Riley tries to prove otherwise, Lynsey fears she still has cause to worry about him and Mitzeee. Brendan confronts Walker about Joel's discovery, but Walker insists that Joel doesn't know the full story and reveals a new side of himself to Brendan.

Joel's unnerved by Walker's continued presence in the village, while Lynsey calls time on her relationship with Riley, admitting that she can't be second best to Mitzeee. But with Mitzeee heading away on business, will Riley tell her the truth before it's too late? Carmel pulls out all the stops to prepare for the Face of Attwells competition, but her actions have horrifying results.

Mitzeee's sudden return from New York makes Nancy suspicious, but then they meet gorgeous footballer Jay... could he be everything Mitzeee has ever wanted? Carmel struggles to come to terms with the news that her injuries will never fully heal and ends up on the hospital roof. Doug's confidence with Ste is shaken when a bitter Brendan makes his presence felt.

When a sick Riley needs help, Mitzeee is torn; should she choose the man she loves or a dream date with Jay? Lynsey finds a distraught Carmel on the hospital roof; can she talk her down in time? Doug feels increasingly emasculated when he realises that Ste used to fancy Ally; is he man enough for his boyfriend?

Mitzeee puts it all on the line when she declares her love for Riley, but his reaction isn't what she expected. Will Riley have a change of heart when he finds out about Mitzeee's sacrifice? Darren and Rhys feel taken for granted by their wives, so they head to The Dog, determined to show them who's boss. Brendan continues to mess with Ste and Doug.

Tensions rise to the surface during a lads' night out as Brendan taunts his friends and neighbours. Determined to put an end to the problem, Rhys, Dodger and Darren decide to stand up to the crook, but drunken posturing gets them in trouble.

Riley goes all out to declare his feelings for Mitzeee, little knowing that Mercedes has misunderstood and thinks he loves her. How will this love triangle be resolved? Phoebe tries to play marriage counsellor to Jacqui and Rhys, but is their relationship beyond repair? Newly empowered Doug finally sleeps with Ste, but their happiness is destroyed by an unwelcome visitor.

A loved-up Mitzeee and Riley prepare to go public, but a humiliated Mercedes is determined to put an end to their happiness and decides to turn the heat up on Mitzeee. Walker warns Ally to keep schtum about his past, but when a passing Lynsey witnesses it, Walker's oblivious to the fact that he's put someone else on his trail.

With the return of her stalker, Mitzeee starts to lose her grip on reality and a night out with the girls descends into chaos as her paranoia reaches new heights. Riley is horrified when he realises the true extent of the situation, but when a faux-concerned Mercedes learns that her plan is working, she decides to pay Mitzeee a visit.

Will has a difficult decision to make when a journalist offers him a large sum of money for his story but his choice has consequences for Dodger. Forced to reconsider her religion, Carmel feels her dysfunctional family aren't taking her crisis of faith seriously. Tilly and Jen continue their secret love affair, but when Tilly feels torn between her friends and her lover, who will she choose?

Jacqui's concerns for Mercedes grow as Doctor Browning struggles to convince Mercedes that they have a future together - is Mercedes falling for him in spite of herself? Later, Mercy lands herself in even more trouble when she's kidnapped… Meanwhile, Tilly is comforted by Neil as she struggles to accept Jen's news. But is Tilly prepared to roll over so easily?

Still hurting following Jen's revelation, Tilly acts out and finds herself in trouble with the police after stealing Jen's car. Meanwhile, struggling to get her head around recent revelations, Mercedes focuses her attentions back on Riley. Elsewhere, Texas's leaving party forces Dodger to take action, but are his words enough to stop her from leaving?

Riley makes a surprising proposition that opens up the possibility of Mercedes' dreams coming true, and Dodger reels from the previous day's events. A newly returned Maddie turns the group against Esther, and Myra settles back into the family fold, but Jacqui suspects something is amiss.

Tensions run high in the village as the day of Mitzeee's hearing arrives, and as the would-be Wag prepares to meet her fate, Mercedes continues to plot against her. Meanwhile, the newly released Myra appears to be hiding a secret, and Phoebe furthers her agenda by giving unreliable relationship advice to George.

Dirk tries to offer Dodger some fatherly advice, but the gesture only serves to irritate him further. Martha struggles to resist toasting Lacey's 16th birthday, and Jacqui begins to notice something unusual about Myra's behaviour. Meanwhile, Nancy inadvertently gives Mercedes just what she wants when she questions Riley about his affections, and Theresa is tempted by an offer guaranteed to bring…

Dodger finds a scrap of evidence about the identity of his real father, while Ash confronts Martha about her behaviour and its impact on the rest of the Kanes. A jealous Joel delivers an ultimatum to Theresa after hearing about her new job, and Jacqui comes up with an unusual way of getting through to Myra.

Dodger will take a turn for the worse and drown his sorrows, worried he will never find his true father. The Kane family will be in tatters following Martha's disappearance, did Ash push things too far? Myra will get back to her old self, and find an unusual way of letting out her anger. Elsewhere, an angry Theresa will look to someone new for comfort... will she be making a huge mistake?

A red mist will descend on the vision of a young Scottish Foxy, following the events of the night before. Will he be able to forgive Theresa? A guilty Ash will refuse to stand by and watch her family fall apart, but is it too late for her to save them?

With the start of term looming, Esther and Ruby are dreading their first day at college, but will they be able to overcome their fears? The Kanes realise their cupboard is truly bare and are offered help from a budding friend.

Following a nightmare first day at college, things go from bad to worse for Esther when Jack catches her skiving. And, with wedding preparations in full swing, Ste and Dennis are united in their misery.
Dennis saves the day for Leanne, but Ste is at the end of his tether. How will Jen cope with a surprise new addition to her class?
As the wedding day approaches, Dennis proves indispensable in keeping secrets, but he is having serious doubts. And, as Doug digs deeper, Ste issues an ultimatum.
Mercedes is causing chaos in the village again, but has she pushed Nancy too far this time?

An unscrupulous Mercedes threatens Nancy and her baby, but will it be enough to stop Nancy's quest for justice? Leanne is still in the midst of wedding fever and Walker gets defensive when the doctor makes it clear that Cam's prognosis isn't good.
Darren urges Nancy to take it easy. Mercedes puts on the performance of her life when Mitzeee hears the outcome of her trial. Theresa's frustrated that she's not getting any alone time with Joel.
Joel's mum begs Theresa not to tell him her secret. The Kanes are soon struggling when Ash is unable to pay the rent. Jacqui seeks help from Frankie about Phoebe.
Theresa plans a birthday surprise for Joel. Lacey devises a fun-filled money making scheme to help pay the rent. Bart and Neil play a prank on Jono.
There's chemistry in the kitchen when Ste helps Brendan prepare Joel's birthday dinner party. A bitter Maddie tells Ruby that Jono has a new girlfriend.

The aftermath of the party causes ripples for the Kanes. While Rhys is busy trying to hold his family together, Jacqui and Myra enjoy a night on the town, and Cindy is left feeling neglected when Tony leaves her to spend an evening with the students.

As Ally continues to get the Kanes back on track, Callum is left wondering if he's too good to be true. Phoebe and Esther bond over their shared hatred of Maddie and, in an attempt to make Tony notice her, Cindy flirts with Rhys.
Callum is given reason to suspect that Ally isn't all he seems, while Maddie makes an effort to befriend Phoebe - but does she have an ulterior motive?
Callum's efforts to expose Ally lead to some major revelations. Meanwhile, Esther's fashion showcase ends in humiliation.
Phoebe determines to make Maddie pay, while Leanne attempts to heal the growing rift between Doug and Ste.
Doug makes a life-changing decision when he realises he needs to accept Ste's history with Brendan or move on, while the students find their dream apartment but are bound by Tony's tenancy agreement.
Riley is shocked by a surprise visitor, while Bart decides it's not quite time to face reality.
Mercedes makes a horrifying discovery, while Bart lies about his antics in an effort to win back Sinead.
A devastated Mercedes and Riley struggle to cope with events, while Darren realises Nancy is in touch with Mitzeee and begs her to go to the police.
Mercedes makes a shocking accusation on live TV, while Nancy agrees to help a frightened Mitzeee.
Riley comes up short of funds, so the village pulls together to help his cause.
Riley is forced to break Mitzeee's heart, while Ste is caught in the crossfire of an on-going feud.
Nancy and Darren fear for the future of their tiny baby. Jacqui can't believe that Myra has remained loyal to Mercedes, knowing what she did.
There's tension between Nancy, who is scared, and Darren, who is angry. Ste points the finger of blame at an unsuspecting resident for the recent trauma.
Darren's temper flares as he realises how much danger his wife exposed their child to.

Struggling to deal with the loss of Mercedes and Bobby, Myra becomes a cause for concern to Dirk. Darren goes full throttle and tells Nancy what he really thinks, but can Jack talk him round? Rhys tries his best to lure Cindy into some bedroom shenanigans. Despite her best efforts to please everyone, Esther is made to look a fool.

Cindy is getting frustrated with Rhys's pestering and heads to the McQueens' to call it off, but can she resist temptation? Meanwhile, Nancy is buoyed by a visit from Tom, but wonders what's got into Darren when he goes AWOL. Elsewhere, Myra decides it's time to remedy her wrongs and heads to Nana McQueen's.

Darren and Nancy are anxious as their baby fights a serious infection. Rob and Liam develop a rivalry when Atwell's new manager is revealed. While Tony is away, Rhys and Cindy decide to play, but will they get found out? Myra resolves to get the McQueens back together, while Esther is further divided from her friends as the video publishers become known.

Darren and Nancy appear to be back on track when the family gather together at the baby's christening. Tony's suspicions are misplaced after a rather green Cindy makes her escape. Jacqui confronts Rhys about his antics, while Esther is further ostracised when she is blamed for breaking Jen's sculpture. Ash's decision to prove her domestic goddess status to Ally doesn't last long.

Darren and Rhys unwind at Ash and Ally's party. Stood up by Bart, Sinead drowns her sorrows and catches the eye of Rob and the guys. George bears the brunt of Esther's wrath when she realises the gang have read her personal letter, while Tony believes his suspicions about Cindy are confirmed.
Rhys distances himself from Cindy when rumours surface that she's pregnant. Esther decides to skive college, but is mortified by Jack's punishment.
As Tony's world comes crashing down he decides it's time for action and won't take no for an answer... Ally plays cupid for Lacey and Dylan, while Esther attracts unwanted attention.
Tony is determined to prove his love for Cindy, while Ash, Callum and Lacey are devastated when Martha doesn't show up for coffee.
A forlorn Ruby is left out of the fold, but desperate to get back in with Sinead and Maddie.
Lacey decides to play it cool with Dylan, but will she end up regretting it? Brendan tries to help with Lynsey's funeral but Cheryl keeps him at a distance.

Lynsey's brother Eoghan arrives in the village, leaving Ste wondering about his past with Brendan and Cheryl. Meanwhile, Rhys is surprised by Cindy and Tony's engagement, and Cindy's necklace causes confusion. Elsewhere, spurred on by Ally, Lacey and Dylan share a kiss - but Lacey wonders if he's the only one who fancies her.
Cheryl goes in search of answers from an unlikely source. Ste offers a saddened Brendan a shoulder to cry on and Lacey snubs a confused Dylan in pursuit of another beau.
Brendan tries to be there for his sister but will Cheryl let him? Darren's mouth gets him into trouble and a dejected Cindy wants attention, but is Tony the man for the job?

Dodger gives Tom advice on women, not realising who the true object of his affection is. Jono and Bart are at loggerheads and battle it out on the army assault course. Finally, Jen attempts to boost Esther's self-esteem, but is it in vain?
Darren is wary as Tom finds excuses to hang out with Texas and Dodger, while Jono makes a surprising decision. Meanwhile, Esther is given food for thought by her online chum.
Neil and Bart join forces to try to convince Jono not to join the army. Esther decides to stand against Maddie at college and Jacqui's stunned as Rhys makes a shocking declaration.
A surprise visitor causes tension between Ste and Doug, while Myra worries about her daughter's marriage.

As Cindy is offered a chance to escape, a call from the hospital makes her question everything. Esther is left humiliated when the teenagers plot a prank against her and Doug is stunned as Brendan continues to come between him and Ste.
As things look bleak for Tony, he offers Cindy a way out. Doug is incensed as Brendan saves the day for Ste again.
Cindy faces a tough choice, while Jono asks Ruby to make a life-changing decision.

The village is reeling with excitement from the unexpected arrival of a familiar figure. Lacey develops an illicit crush, but are her feelings returned? Frankie goes to extreme lengths to stop Ruby from making a horrible mistake.
There's trouble in town as a mischievous newcomer arrives in Hollyoaks. Joel finds himself in a precarious situation, and Cheryl admits to Tony that there is a slight complication with their big day.

Mitzeee finds out there's still a hidden secret that could change her life for ever. Myra struggles financially, finding charity from the most unlikely source. Callum is surprised at Martha's honesty.
Mitzeee is dealt some difficult news and, at the Kanes', things heat up for Lacey. As Esther offers Ruby a heartfelt gift, she is once again thwarted by Maddie.

With Jacqui believing her relationship with Rhys is on the mend, will Rhys be able to tell her the truth, or will he leave Hollyoaks for ever? Jono is faced with an important decision and, either way, he will hurt someone.
Who will Tony reveal his secret to? And, with her big day looming, will Ruby get cold feet?
On the morning of the wedding, Ste makes a shocking discovery and Esther faces the threat of Maddie's wrath.

A catastrophic accident threatens to destroy lives in the village as Esther and Bart's antics push Maddie to the limit. While Doug can't let go of the past, Ste finally discovers the truth about Brendan. Is Hollyoaks destined for any happy endings?
In the aftermath of the accident, Hollyoaks falls into disrepair. Things are put in perspective for many in the village, but how much longer can the truth stay buried?
One resident hears life-changing news, but can they live with the consequences? And just when they thought they were safe, tragedy strikes for one much-loved couple.
In the aftermath of the devastating crash, Phoebe struggles to retain her silence about what she knows, and Lacey seeks solace in an unlikely friend.

As Ash struggles to articulate her emotions, and Lacey's illicit feelings intensify, are the Kanes headed for disaster? And when Dodger receives a piece of life-changing information, he is once again left torn.
Dodger makes the bold choice to meet his real dad as one resident's grief causes havoc in the village.
Dodger is faced with a shocking revelation, and Lacey's forbidden infatuation escalates.
Barney arrives back in the village but someone has a proposition for him. Will Carmel's first day at work help her confidence?
Martha becomes increasingly suspicious of Ally's behaviour, while Nana McQueen takes it on herself to play matchmaker for Carmel.
Martha confirms her worst fears. Texas makes a decision that could change things for ever. Carmel faces her own insecurities, while Nana wonders if she's done the right thing.
With Sienna's help, Dodger tries to set matters right, while things heat up in Barney's love life.
Dodger plans a surprise in order to bring his family together. Mitzeee tells Maxine to find a job, but her sister has other ideas, while Ash considers giving Martha another chance.
Jacqui is on self-destruct, while Dodger and Dirk face a difficult choice. Maxine decides Mitzeee needs her support, but can she remind her sister how to have fun?
Sinead is faced with a monumental decision, while it's time for Mitzeee to face Mercedes again.
As lawyer Jim paints a very black and white picture for Mercedes, is Mitzeee strong enough to take her on? Diane and Bart learn of Sinead's plans, but can they change her mind?
Jim unknowingly complicates things when he welcomes a star witness in the dock. Doug and Ste struggle to cope with the stress of family life.
It's judgement day for Mercedes, and Carmel receives attention from an unlikely figure, but are his feelings reciprocated?
Surprise arrivals in Hollyoaks deal Doug some shattering news. Sienna and Texas attempt to cast aside their differences for the sake of Dodger.
On the day of the crash inquest, Esther's world comes tumbling down, while Doug and Ste are in utter turmoil when they face a life-changing decision.
Doug pushes Ste to the limits, while Esther is faced with Maddie, Jono and Neil's memorial. Jacqui enlists Cindy's help with the funeral.

It's the day of Rhys's funeral. When Tony is asked to give a speech, can he bring himself to praise the man who was sleeping with his wife? Or will he publicly expose Rhys's infidelity? Meanwhile, Jacqui seeks solace in an old friend as Cindy prepares to say a painful goodbye to the man that she loves.

Jacqui finds a clue which leads her directly to the heart of Rhys's disloyalty, only to be met with a devastating discovery. Meanwhile, cracks begin to form among the Savages, but can anybody help Dodger and Dirk see sense? Elsewhere, Theresa prepares for Joel's release from prison before being dealt some shocking news.

As the differences between his two families transpire, how will Dodger cope? Meanwhile, Texas is left confused and reeling when Sienna attempts to stir trouble within an already fractured family. Elsewhere, at the Christmas lights switch-on, Maxine has her eyes set on one guy only, but are the feelings mutual?

As Doug and Ste bid farewell to the village, Cheryl is left questioning Ste's affections, but is it too late? Meanwhile, Texas's fear mounts as Sienna and Dodger spend time alone, knowing her secret is a ticking time bomb. Can Texas bring herself to tell Dodger the truth? Elsewhere, seeing Bart shattered by Sinead's rejection, Jacqui makes a devastating decision.
Cheryl makes a revelation that leaves Doug in utter turmoil. As Theresa maps out the future, Joel makes an executive decision.
Leanne is overjoyed when an old friend returns to lend a helping hand, and Maxine and Mitzeee make a deal that can only lead to disaster.
Nancy fears the worst when she receives a call from the hospital. When Maxine struggles to stick to her promise, can she keep another secret from her sister?
Maxine and Mitzeee make a scandalous discovery, and Nana McQueen is dazed by a shock confession from Barney.

It’s the day of the Christmas ball! After confiding in a friend about his secret arrangement, Barney prepares to admit his true affections to Carmel... will she get the fairy-tale ending of her dreams? Elsewhere, Brendan struggles to cope with his overwhelming situation, while an isolated Mercedes gets a surprise visitor knocking on her door.

The McQueen's world is rocked when a mystery bundle arrives with no explanation. On her first Christmas without Rhys, Jacqui's emotions run high as she makes a heart-breaking discovery, with disastrous consequences... Worried for Carmel, Myra overhears the events of last night and throws one McQueen out in the cold. Is Christmas over for this lonely figure?

As Jacqui learns the full extent of Rhys's infidelity, she leans on Tony for support. Could there still be a spark between the pair? Meanwhile, Darren and Nancy are struggling with parenthood, but could there be an underlying issue? Elsewhere, seeing Mercedes upset, Browning concocts a plan to get back in favour with the McQueens'.

Darren and Nancy's worry increases as they seek professional advice at the hospital over their fears that Oscar could be deaf. Meanwhile, Myra's fears for the future escalate as she finds out what she thought was a hangover could be something worse.

When a social worker turns up to look into the situation at the Osbornes' following Charlie's disappearance, they soon realise they can't continue to go on the way they have been.However when Ruby blames Esther for not watching Charlie she finds solace at Mitzeee's. Cheryl tries to get Brendan and Seamus to bond over a lunch at the dog, however when Brendan storms out she gives him a ultimatum.
Things end up becoming even more tense for the Osbornes. Esther manages to find friendship in a trusted source.

Cheryl's concern escalates over Seamus's disappearance. Can Brendan keep his terrible secret? Meanwhile, a harassed Joel deals Theresa heartbreaking news, but can she change his mind? Elsewhere, Mercedes manages to make inroads with Myra, but there's trouble ahead when Mercy jumps to the wrong conclusion. Also today, Bart fears that he'll never be able to turn over a new leaf.

It's the day of Myra's fundraiser, and a familiar figure arrives back to hear of recent events at the McQueens'. Meanwhile, Dodger is left reeling from yet another shocking discovery. Elsewhere, as Esther's bullying continues, nothing can prepare her for what she is about to see.
As Tilly vows to expose the truth, Jen takes drastic measures to stop her. Things go from bad to worse for Phoebe, and Brendan surprises himself and Ste as he looks after Leah.

Ste is taken aback as Doug returns, seeming happier than ever. Will he accept Doug's proposition? Meanwhile, Mitzeee pushes Brendan on his past, but can he reveal all? Elsewhere, with the truth laying heavy on Jen's conscience, can she bring herself to expose it and risk her career?

Ste is rattled when Brendan questions his commitment. Can Ste reveal the truth about his relationship to Amy? At the same time, as Mitzeee encourages Brendan to face up to his past, a shady figure intervenes… and an old enemy returns. Meanwhile, following yesterday's revelations, Jacqui rallies the McQueens into action - but the news that Carmel has some savings doesn't provide relief for long as…

Ste worries about his future with Brendan, but Brendan makes the bold choice to live with Ste. Meanwhile, Ash and Barney come up with a daring plan to help Will, disguising him as an old woman to break him out of the hospital. But could the plan backfire? Elsewhere, the McQueens' attempts to go straight have disastrous consequences for everyone as they end up in a massive bar brawl.

Cooped up in a prison cell, the McQueens find themselves seeking help from Jim McGinn once again - but for what repayment? Meanwhile, as John Paul struggles with the pressure of being a job-seeking single parent, a shock visit turns his world upside down. Elsewhere, panic strikes the village as time is ticking for Will, who has disappeared amid the chaos of his party.

John Paul makes it his mission to infuriate Ste at the careers day by undermining him in front of the students, and the pair end up fighting in the school corridors. Meanwhile, chaos reigns in the Osborne household as Nancy is forced to confront her worst nightmare, but is there more heartache yet to come?

Nancy's suspicions intensify when Darren returns from a night out and she demands to know what's going on - has he been with Cindy? How much longer can Darren hide the truth for, and at what cost? Meanwhile, Brendan returns to the village from Ireland but doesn't receive a warm welcome from Ste.

Darren concocts an elaborate plan to secure his family's future. Can things between Trudy and Jacqui get much worse? And can Ste and Brendan overcome the obstacles in the way of taking their relationship to the next level?
As tension mounts, can Leanne resolve the chaos she's caused before it's too late? Darren panics under pressure, but can he save the day?
How will the Osbornes cope with the consequences of the previous night? Tony steps in to save the day. Is Cheryl having reservations about Nate?
Leanne gives some controversial advice, but will her idea work? Seamus grows suspicious of his daughter's new man.
Seamus reveals his uncertainties about Nate. Will Dodger admit how he really feels to Theresa?

Walker issues a lethal ultimatum, putting Maxine at serious risk, but can Kevin bring himself to fulfill such a deadly task? Ruby prepares for her first day back at college, but will this former bully be easily forgiven? Will manipulates an awkward situation. Precisely what is he planning?

Still shocked by what he saw last night, can Will confide in anyone without revealing his own sordid secret? Elsewhere, Sinead is forced to make a serious life decision, and the full horror of Kevin’s dishonesty is unveiled. Things go from bad to worse for the McQueens, but is there more to Trudy’s cleaning company than she’s letting on? Meanwhile, Cindy unwittingly pushes Holly further away.
Sinead anxiously awaits Diane's life-changing decision. Has a concerned Leanne isolated a resolute Texas even further? Jacqui's day takes a shocking turn as she is confronted by her worst nightmare.

Will Jacqui open up to anyone about her ordeal? As Kevin understands the full repercussions of his actions, can he hide such a big secret from Walker? When Cheryl's surprise to Nate backfires, will she lose everything she's ever dreamed of?

A shock proposal leaves Cheryl contemplating the opportunity of a lifetime, while Trudy tempts Jacqui into becoming her accomplice. Brendan decides to take matters into his own hands after lawyer Jim McGinn reveals the dire truth about his case, and a terrified Kevin finds himself cornered.
Seamus offers Cheryl an offer to rival yesterday's, but which will she choose? The Osbornes hear some shocking news. As Walker learns the magnitude of Kevin's deceit, could Kevin be in mortal danger?
Things heat up for Walker, but what exactly does he have planned? Is it game over for Kevin? Could there be more to Ellie than Will is aware of?

A nostalgic Tony attempts to rekindle his relationship with Jacqui, but has he missed his chance? Meanwhile, to what extremes will Nancy go to fuel her addiction? Elsewhere, Jacqui reveals heartbreaking news to Doctor Browning, but will he believe her?

A mystery woman in red posts a photo of a gagged Mercedes to Browning, shortly followed by the return of Clare Devine. Has she done something to Mercy? Meanwhile, wrongly assuming that George's one-night stand was with John Paul, Phoebe decides to teach JP a lesson by mugging him. Will her actions prove costly?

Doctor Browning is confronted by an unwanted visitor, but how does he know them? Meanwhile, Jacqui and the McQueens beg John Paul to withdraw his statement to protect Phoebe, but it's too late as she already has a court date. Worried over her uncertain future, Phoebe hits the bottle.

Jacqui is on the warpath in the fallout from Phoebe's collapse. With Trudy refusing to take the vodka off the shelves, Jacqui decides to get rid of it all in her own way - by smashing it up. Meanwhile, new boy Robbie Roscoe is introduced to Patrick at college. It's clear there's a devilish side to this newcomer, but Patrick is up for the challenge.

Tilly has planted Esther's tell-all diary in John Paul's pigeon hole at college, with details of her and Jen's affair in it. At the college open day, Jen is proud to be giving a speech to the prospective parents, but she's humiliated when images of her and Tilly in various romantic clinches are projected behind her – busted!

Romance blossoms for Tony, but his recent sacrifices threaten to scupper the success of his new business. Later, Jacqui decides that it's time Tony knew what really happened between her and Trudy in prison, so she makes a shock confession. Meanwhile, Tilly finds an unlikely ally as she attempts to rid the village of Jen for good.

Chez Chez is up for auction and it's a race to the finish line for the prospective bidders. Despite Liam's departure, Maxine hopes to be able to afford the club thanks to a loan from Mitzeee. At the same time, Clare is still hopeful that Browning will step up and invest in the club.

Leanne confronts Will and is further shocked when she discovers a shoebox filled with CCTV DVDs - what kind of sick person is he? Can Leanne bring herself to tell her Texas the ghastly truth? Meanwhile, the McQueens fall into despair as the stakes are raised, with a £200,000 ransom being demanded in exchange for Mercedes's safe return. But does Jacqui have an idea up her sleeve?

Pushed to the extremes in order to secure Mercy's safe return, will Jacqui shake hands with the devil? Meanwhile, Leanne leans in to kiss Will, but will it prove to be a costly mistake? Elsewhere, Maxine is jubilant after receiving fantastic news, but for how long can her good mood last? Also today, Carmel offers a shoulder for petrified Myra.

The McQueens concoct a plan to save Mercedes, but to what extremes are they willing to go? Meanwhile, as Callum is left feeling dejected, who will he turn to? Elsewhere, Sinead and Diane are gobsmacked when Sinead's dad Rob returns and delivers the shocking news that Finn has gone missing. Also today, Tony is left questioning his future as his Decree Absolute arrives.

Jacqui prepares to meet with Trevor and trick him into buying a supposedly vodka-laden truck for £50,000. She is shocked when Phoebe jumps into the van with her - she's not budging. Later, when Jacqui hears a crash from the back of the van, she is alarmed to find five illegal immigrants smuggled away. What will she do about it?

Sinead is horrified after being involved in running over her own brother Finn. With Finn's memory hazy, can Sinead cover for deceitful Robbie despite their wrongdoing? Meanwhile, with extremes of life or death, how much are Phoebe and Jacqui prepared to risk? Elsewhere, Tony is left with tough decisions to make. Also today, Diane is stunned to the core by a piece of life-changing news.

Jacqui is offered one final opportunity to save her sister, but is it too late? Meanwhile, Nancy has arranged for Darren to do an interview with the Herald about his win on the horses, but he refuses to do it. Nancy questions her husband and is horrified when he tells her the truth about the betting slip.

Jacqui's day takes a terrifying turn. Later, after planning her getaway, Jacqui says an emotional goodbye to Phoebe and departs the village alone. Meanwhile, can deceived Nancy find it in her to forgive and forget? Or will she finally admit to her own dishonesties?
An unwelcome figure from Tom's past returns to Hollyoaks, while Carmal begins to see Jim in a new light.
Secrets and lies are revealed at Texas' hen du, meanwhile, Mercedes is wracked with guilt.

Texas is faced with a difficult decision when Will tells her that he has a life-threatening aneurism. But what will she choose - her head, or her heart? Meanwhile, Myra feels compelled to tell Carmel the truth, but will she break Carmel's heart? Elsewhere, Mercedes goes to extreme lengths to settle her debts with a family member.
A familiar face turns up on Maxine's doorstep, Sinead goes into labor and Ste returns to Hollyoaks, but it doesn't take long before he loses control.
Patrick's hostility towards Maxine's new flatmate pushes him to extremes. Meanwhile, Finn makes a plan that could save his family and Ste makes a shocking confession to Doug.
Ste and Doug need to put there differences aside in order to win a prestigious food competition. Callum gets on Robbie's bad side and Maxine tries to deal with her true emotions.

Ste may have finally found a solution to his financial problems, while Robbie throws a rave at Chez Chez. Phoebe is shocked when she sees a familiar face from her past. Meanwhile, Robbie tries to get revenge on Callum, but when his plan goes badly it means life or death for someone else.

It's the day of Tony's operation, so Darren decides to tell Cindy about Tony's condition. She rushes to the hospital and reassures Tony that he's not alone anymore. Meanwhile, Ste is desperate to get back into Freddie's good books, but the newcomer is refusing to supply him.

eps.t: Plots and Plans: Myra's Final Week
eps.d: As the McQueens become aware of Dr. Browning’s evil plan, is there anything they can do to save their family? Meanwhile, Ziggy is desperate to prove that he’s not under the thumb when it comes to Ruby, Vincent thinks he might have found the answer to his prayers and Cindy struggles to control her agoraphobia.

Mercedes is devastated at the risky, extreme lengths she has to go to protect her mum, but will her efforts be in vain? Or will Dr. Browning get his own way, with devastating consequences? Elsewhere, George can’t deny his feelings any longer, but how will Vincent respond?

A distraught Mercedes seeks the ultimate revenge on Dr Browning, but will she put herself in danger? George and Vincent settle their differences, whilst Phoebe gets the shock of her life. Sandy is speechless as an old face arrives back in the village, and the McQueens realise that life will never be the same again.

The McQueens are left utterly broken by the week’s events, but can Jim provide a glimmer of hope to one family member? Meanwhile, the Roscoes are aghast to hear of their brother’s recent torment, and the threat of Trevor still looms over the village.

The Roscoes are dealt some shocking news, but, despite wanting to think the best of her sons, Sandy’s suspicions are piqued. Vincent is forced to make a difficult decision, but who will he choose: George or Phoebe? Elsewhere, Sinead is interrogated by the police.

Will's jealousy and paranoia continues to increase. Can anybody stop him from murdering again? Jack tries to hide his dishonesty from his wife, but will Frankie realise his deceit? The McQueens struggle to come to terms with the loss of their loved one. Meanwhile, Patrick makes a devastating discovery that could shatter his family forever.

A guilty Will struggles to deal with the consequences of his actions, but has he done enough to cover his tracks, or will he find himself caught out? Patrick receives yet another blow as he is held fully accountable for yesterday's events. The McQueens receive yet more distressing news, but do they have an illicit idea up their sleeves?

As a furious Jack makes an emotional Frankie apologise to Sandy for her behaviour, Lindsey is in the wrong place at the wrong time - with devastating consequences. As those that surround him become suspicious, are the walls finally closing in on Will? Dennis is roped into Nana McQueen's risky plan, but can he go through with it?

As tensions run high, could Dennis and Leanne's wedding be called off? Lindsey is rushed into hospital, leaving Joe utterly distraught. Could Frankie be to blame for this tragedy? Old feelings are resurrected for Carmel, and elsewhere, Trevor is given food for thought. Meanwhile, Patrick comes to a shocking realisation.

Emotions escalate for the Roscoes as Frankie refuses to lay old worries to rest, but has Jack done enough to convince everyone otherwise? Freddie struggles to keep his distance as he watches a loved on grieve. Trevor decides to get pay back, but how far will he go? Meanwhile, a proposal leaves smiles all round.

It's finally the day of Frankie and Jack's wedding vow renewal, but can they put the problems of the past behind them to ensure they have a day to remember? As trouble erupts in The Dog, Sandy makes a gobsmacking admission, while Joe gets the shock of his life. Meanwhile, Trevor and Fraser plot the ultimate revenge of a deceitful Jim.

With recent events hanging heavy in the air, could this be the end of an era for the Osborne family? Or will Jack's desperate attempts to reconcile prevail? Elsewhere, still reeling from yesterday's shocking news and coming to terms with his recent grief, is Joe nearing breaking point? His brother Freddie isn't fairing much better, as his jealousy hits a raw nerve with Sinead.

With her relationship on the rocks, Frankie surprises herself as she seeks comfort in the arms of a family acquaintance. Freddie is forced to perform a terrifying task, but will it go to plan? Meanwhile, Sienna asks Darren to take their relationship the next step.

Freddie watches on aghast as his mission doesn't quite go as planned, especially when he discovers who has been trapped inside! Meanwhile, feeling flustered and embarrassed, Frankie is desperate to keep her actions a secret, but will she succeed? Will Fraser pull off his cruel plot to frame Jim? And Sienna shows her true colours while fighting to keep Darren happy.

Backed into a corner by Fraser and faced with a moral predicament, what will Jim decide to do? Freddie admits to his demons, but will he lose the love and respect of those close to him? Elsewhere, as Maxine is left high and dry, who will she turn to for support? Sienna is overjoyed as her plan begins to fall into place, but Frankie's ruin serves as a cold reminder to her malicious actions.

A guilty Maxine is overwhelmed by Patrick's persistence to win her back, but will she reveal whose bed she was in last night? As Jim desperately tries to get out of his illicit arrangement, will he succeed? Meanwhile, despite his best efforts, nothing can prepare Joe for Lindsey's heart-breaking revelation and Ste is stunned to receive help from an unlikely source.

It's the day of Ste's court hearing and Doug pulls out all the stops to keep his friend out of jail; but still feeling an overwhelming sense of guilt, how will Ste plead? Elsewhere, Maxine is desperate to save her relationship, but will she succeed? Joe and Lindsey are on the rocks, but can they sort out their differences?

As things heat up between John Paul and Danny, the McQueen gets the shock of his life. Meanwhile, after this week's shocking discovery, pressure mounts on Fraser and Trevor, but what exactly are they planning? Fraser and Trevor attempt to frame an innocent villager for their nasty deed, but will they succeed with their malicious plan? Meanwhile, has Ste managed to exorcise his demons, and can John Paul really call it a day with his secret lover Danny? Will makes a show of himself in front of a concerned crowd, but can Ash forgive him?

Meanwhile, Dodger is shocked to discover a piece of Will's disturbing past and Doug and Ste make an impulsive, heart-driven decision.

It's Mercedes' 30th birthday (woohoooo!) and she's determined to celebrate in true McQueen style, but a face from the past has plans to make sure the party goes off with a bang… Ste and Doug prepare to say goodbye to Hollyoaks, but will Danny reveal the truth to Ste before it's too late?

A horrified Ash confronts Will about his past crimes, but how far is he prepared to go to secure her silence? Mercedes' birthday celebrations are in full swing, but the McQueens are unaware of the explosive surprise that's in store for them. Sinead has bagged a leaving present for Ste and Doug, which could change their lives forever.

The whole village is reeling from the explosion and a desperate mission to find survivors gets underway, but who or what will they uncover? An unexpected visitor arrives at the McQueens, but will they get the reception they'd hoped for? Elsewhere, Lindsey and Cindy find themselves forced to face their demons, and Will's feud with Dodger is brought to a shocking conclusion…

As the dust settles, the Savages pull together as they try to deal with their grief. Everyone is stunned when paramedics uncover another body in the rubble…but whose? Sam resolves that she will find the person responsible for the tragedy and Cindy and Lindsey find themselves bonded by a dark secret.

Cindy and Lindsey struggle with the burden of their secrets, but Lindsey is left speechless with Cindy admits she has one more confession to make. Sam makes a discovery which threatens to turn her life upside down. The Osbornes are faced with utter devastation, meanwhile, Holly struggles to come to terms with her grief and Dennis has to break life-shattering news...

Having discovered Danny’s ultimate betrayal, Sam struggles to fine it in her heart to forgive him. As pressure mounts for Cindy and Lindsey, who will be the first to crack? And meanwhile, as the Osbornes near breaking point, could Nancy return to save the day?

Holly is left gobsmacked by Cindy’s revelation, but will Cindy listen to her daughter’s honest opinion? Meanwhile, with health results looming, how will Tony cope under the pressure? Sienna is forced to make a difficult decision to save a loved one, but how will it be executed? Elsewhere, Phoebe goes back to her old ways, and Patrick makes a discovery that rocks his world (EEK!).

Tony takes a trip down memory lane with Diane but their plans are thrown into chaos when Diane’s waters break and she is rushed into hospital. While Diane is in labour, Tony receives some shocking news of his own!

Danny makes a surprise announcement that knocks his family for six, but how will they respond to his life-changing news? Elsewhere, laden with fury over his recent betrayal, Patrick turns to someone for comfort, but will the real truth behind his girlfriend’s actions be revealed? Meanwhile, Vincent returns back to the village, but is he a changed man?

When a furious Patrick organises a devious plan to make Maxine confess, he makes an alarming discovery. Devastated that Ziggy has moved on so quickly, is there anything Ruby can do to win the man of her dreams back? Meanwhile, Vincent’s decision leaves Phoebe and George flabbergasted, while Danny is distraught to be faced with an impossible ultimatum.

At the memorial service, one of the Savage brothers struggles to retain their silence. Will he keep quiet? And Vincent is back! He struggles to adjust to life back in Hollyoaks, leading to Phoebe making a shock proposition. Maxine receives some devastating news, and she doesn't know whether or not she can rely on Patrick for support.

Lindsey decides to spill the beans about Dr Browning's murder to Joe, but will Cindy's secret stop her? The deceit continues as Maxine lies to Patrick to save her relationship, but how long can she outsmart him for? Meanwhile, Vincent and Phoebe make plans for their future but, they face opposition from the McQueens. Will their happiness be short-lived?

Cindy and Lindsey have to take drastic action to cover their criminal tracks. Theresa strikes up an unlikely friendship with a new girl in town, but does her new friend have an ulterior motive? And after so much heartbreak, Maxine and Patrick try to forgive each other against all the odds, although it might not be as easy as they hope.

Lindsey and Cindy know they need to dispose of the evidence, but will anything change their minds? A loved Hollyoaks couple are forced to reunite. How close will they get, and what will the reaction be? In the Roscoe house, Joe is suspicious, but Lindsey is struggling with whether or not to tell him about her dark secret.

Sienna makes a desperate move for quick cash to ensure her sinister plan runs smoothly, but the risks are high. Lindsey tries to show Joe that she is ready for the big commitment, but Joe is struggling to cope with his own regret. Ruby tries her best to win back Ziggy, while he puts his efforts into avoiding her.

Martha is handed a piece of evidence that knocks her for six, is the truth about her Ash's fate about to be uncovered? Sandy and Nancy can't help but be confused by Sienna's behaviour – the odds are finally stacking up against her. Elsewhere, John Paul is left feeling sorry for one of his students.

As her lies accumulate, will Sienna’s evil plan backfire? Dodger's suspicions against his brother increase, but he receives a stern warning from Patrick to watch his step. Feeling guilty, John Paul attempts to put matters to rest and help out a friend, while Tony’s on edge as he wonders if his past will return to haunt him once more.

A frantic Will is driven to the extreme and, in a shocking turn of events, ends up holding his loved ones hostage: who will survive? Elsewhere, Darren is still distressed by Sienna's lack of support, while she leaves a trail of devastation behind her.

As the wounded hostages try to reason with an increasingly manic Will, he cruelly silences anyone that crosses his path. Sienna’s web of lies is threatening to unravel, but can she maintain control of her illicit secret? Meanwhile, the police are hot on to a murderer's tracks, but time is ticking.

In light of yesterday’s tragic events, a villager seeks to make amends with a close source. Sandy is left stunned as she is faced with the truth about Fraser’s identity, but just how much will she learn, and how will she react? Meanwhile, Ste gets on the wrong side of the village bad boy, Finn attempts to reach out to a loved one and Cindy is struggling to forget the ghost of her past…

One intrigued villager turns detective, but will they uncover the truth behind Browning's fate? Desperate, Cindy, Lindsey and Mercedes are forced to face up to their demons. Meanwhile Finn is pushed to the extremes with shocking consequences, and Nancy and Joe are left in an awkward situation.

Freddie finds himself caught up in a spiral of overwhelming events in order to save a loved one and with emotions running high, who will be run to for comfort? And will the feelings be mutual? Elsewhere, Finn and Robbie plot their revenge on an unsuspecting victim, but they could be taking things too far. Will the truth about Joe and Nancy be exposed?

As Patrick catches wind of Finn and Robbie's cruel plan, is trouble in store for John Paul? Meanwhile, Phoebe is left devastated by her mum's harsh antics, and, under pressure, Joe makes a shock confession.

George, Tilly and Esther embark on a road trip to Ireland to stop Phoebe and Vincent from making a colossal mistake, but will they succeed? Meanwhile the Lomaxes can't help but question Danny's motives.

Tony plays with fire as he attempts to cut a deal of his own - will he be taken seriously? And as the evidence is discovered by Diane, will he confess his sins? Darren's suspicions escalate, and Sam receives a stern warning.

Diane's heartache fuels Tony’s guilt, but is it enough for him to come clean? Sienna's left with a difficult decision to make, but will she show any signs of compassion and make the right choice? Worried about the discovery of Dr. Browning, Cindy leads an unsuspecting villager into a trap.

Browning’s body is discovered, but will the investigation into his death reveal his true murderers? Cindy prepares to reveal her dark secret to Dirk, but will he get the wrong end of the stick? As Darren and Nancy grow closer, can Nancy find it in her heart to forgive Darren and move forward? Meanwhile, Cindy knocks the wind out of both Dirk and Mercedes’ sails, and Holly’s uncomfortable with Jason’s sexual advances.

Despite yesterday’s shocking developments, can Lindsey and Joe’s wedding go ahead? Elsewhere, Darren learns of Nancy’s betrayal, Holly and Ruby plot revenge when Holly is left mortified by Jason's antics, and bitter Sienna creates even more drama.

Darren finds himself isolated from all his loved ones, but can he count on Nancy’s support? Sam’s desperation to put Trevor behind bars is apparent, but she doesn't quite have the evidence to send him down. Meanwhile, Freddie makes a shock confession, leaving scorned Sinead devastated. Robbie takes his revenge one step too far, and Sienna is comforted by an unlikely source.

Jason and Robbie find themselves in a dodgy situation... and Robbie's not going to let the culprits get away with it. Elsewhere, Darren finds Sienna in an emotional state, but is there anything he can do to stop her making a regrettable decision? Meanwhile, Maxine’s desperate to prove Patrick wrong and Ruby’s initial excitement is short-lived.

With Jack nowhere to be found, Frankie's attentions turn to a certain someone (mentioning no names, coughZiggycough)... but is he going to be left hanging? Across the village, Sinead is distraught as her love life hits the rocks, a false allegation turns one resident’s world upside down and Darren fights for justice... but a new piece of alarming evidence leaves everyone devastated.

Sienna makes a startling revelation, but will she use the information to help the Osbornes? Meanwhile, Ruby’s suspicions about the Zigmeister (or, err, Ziggy as most people call him) are piqued, Tony’s asked to perform a high risk job, and Robbie attempts to fix things between Holly and Jason.

The village gather to congratulate Tony on his achievement, but he's a bit busy, y'know, being caught up in a LIVING NIGHTMARE.
