Maxine needs to find the courage to save herself and Minnie when they are forced to leave the village. Tony offers to help Darren with ‘Daz Cabs’, but the pairing could be a recipe for disaster. Elsewhere, Dirk is in a dilemma when he receives a letter and he must decide whether to respond to a cry for help.

Life is set to change forever for the Blakes and the Savages, while shockwaves are felt throughout the village when news of an escape spreads. Elsewhere, can Darren swallow his pride and make his new business a success with his meddling best mate?

Dodger is faced with a terrible dilemma when Maxine and Theresa find themselves in danger. Jason takes his first steps on the road to recovery when he’s admitted into an eating disorder facility. Elsewhere, Ste is concerned when he gets a call from a past fling.

Ste has some heart-breaking news for John Paul. Elsewhere, Dodger’s world goes up in flames and he makes a desperate attempt to save the people he loves. His final showdown with Will ends with tragic consequences...

John Paul needs answers but Ste’s behaviour only pushes his husband even further away. The pair wait for news that could affect their lives forever, but will they find the strength to face the future together, or is this a betrayal too far for John Paul?

Myra and Porsche receive some encouraging news about Mercedes, while Nana makes a decision about the McQueens’ future in Hollyoaks. Elsewhere, Freddie and Lindsey settle into their new home, while Nico is haunted by what happened between Will and Dodger, and John Paul struggles to come to terms with the latest bombshell.

With the evidence against him continuing to grow, Lindsey starts to question Freddie’s innocence. Meanwhile, Porsche, Nana and Lockie search for answers of their own. Grace plans something special for Esther but Kim rubs her up the wrong way and can’t believe what she discovers.

Ste’s loved ones rush to him when he sets out for revenge, while Grace, Trevor and Esther are delighted to see their baby for the first time. Elsewhere, there’s a development in Mercedes’ murder case, and Porsche and Celine are shocked by a new arrival.

Freddie has a terrible day as he tries to keep one step ahead of the police, only to be caught at the scene of a crime. Patrick has faith in Nancy and decides to give her an exciting new opportunity at Hollyoaks High, but can she step up to the mark?

Nancy asks Esther for help at the school, but the students get more than they expected when Grace gets involved. Elsewhere, Lindsey makes it her mission to save Freddie from a life behind bars but only lands herself in the firing line.

Lindsey’s actions leave Celine in a terrible dilemma, while a familiar face returns and makes things even more difficult. Dylan leads Peri down a dangerous path, putting her and her schoolmates in danger, while Nancy desperately turns to Trevor for help.

Nancy knows what happened at the school was her fault… but will she find the courage to face the consequences? Elsewhere, Jack makes a potentially life changing decision, while Dirk’s painful admission could come back to haunt him.

Nancy continues to struggle with her pill addiction. It has disastrous consequences, and it’s her family who suffer the fallout. Dylan puts Nico in danger when he suggests that they skip school for the day. Meanwhile, Tegan, Celine and Kim’s prank puts their careers on the line.

Frankie forces Esther to choose between her family and Grace & Trevor, while Robbie, Holly & Phoebe’s big day out ends up in a surprising party at The Loft. Elsewhere, Nico’s actions result in a life-threatening situation for Cindy.

It’s a race against time to save Cindy, and Dirk is faced with a tough choice to make. Maxine opens up to Darren about her past and is surprised when Patrick comes to her rescue. Elsewhere, Dylan warns Esther about his dad, while Trevor threatens Robbie about his recent behaviour.
Dirk’s decision stirs up some unwanted attention, while Holly is disgusted by Robbie’s actions. Kim makes it her mission to spread some joy, with embarrassing consequences for one of her team-mates.
Holly helps Jason settle in at the clinic, while Dirk can’t escape his tormentor. Meanwhile, Tom and Dylan try to call a truce, and Maxine goes to an old foe to help her win custody of Minnie.

Someone is targeting Darren and Maxine, while Ste confides in his old friend Tony about being HIV positive. Elsewhere, Theresa tells Dirk the truth about Myra-Pocahontas but his happiness is short-lived when he receives another threatening reminder about his guilty secret.

In the midst of another row, Diane and Tony are taken back by the return of a familiar face. Elsewhere, Maxine is admitted to hospital, and Peri plots to get rid of Ziggy in a desperate bid for Cameron to return – but she’s shocked when a family secret is revealed.

With her world spiraling out of control, Peri decides to take drastic action, and John Paul’s good mood is ruined by a haunting phone call. Elsewhere, Maxine is shocked when Patrick makes her an offer, leaving her to decide whether to accept for the sake of their daughter.

Ste and Sinead go for a baby scan, while John Paul enlists Trevor's help in getting rid of his demons. Elsewhere, love-sick Tegan offers to help Ziggy plan a Valentine’s Day surprise, but she’s stuck in the middle when Leela reveals her own Valentine’s idea.

Ziggy talks to Tegan about his future with Leela, oblivious to Leela’s big plan, while Porsche’s demands push Lockie down a criminal path, and Diane’s day goes from bad to worse before Patrick’s event at The Hutch. Elsewhere, John Paul has to to choose between Ste and his career.

Porsche locks horns with Trevor over Lockie. It’s the morning after the night before for Diane and she’s shocked by what she’s done. John Paul and Ste’s marriage is put under strain, and JP turns elsewhere for comfort.

Lindsey vows to help Freddie, but there are dangerous consequences in store. John Paul struggles to get his life back on track until a reminder of the past makes things ten times worse. Meanwhile, Cleo grows jealous of Holly and Harry’s friendship.

As John Paul attempts to overcome his demons, Patrick’s intervention could spell big changes for JP’s future. There’s a new development in the Mercedes murder case, while Grace zeroes in on a new ally in her plot against Freddie.

Will it be an all-out war or happy families for the Roscoes when Joe makes a shock appearance at JJ’s naming ceremony? Phoebe is stunned by what she discovers when she finds Mercedes’ diary. Tony invites Ste and John Paul over for tea, but a surprise guest could land John Paul in hot water.

When more evidence stacks up against Freddie, he makes a decision to flee the village. Joe seizes the chance to get Lindsey back, but Lindsey’s got her own agenda. When Tony offers to help Darren with his love life, things do not go to plan. Elsewhere, Cindy doesn't react too well when a newcomer threatens to take away everything she’s worked for.

eps.t: A Father's Love Knows No Bounds
eps.d: Joe makes a desperate attempt to get his son back as Freddie and Lindsey make a quick escape, while Jack faces big decisions about his future. Elsewhere, Cindy starts brewing a cunning plan for one of the village newcomers.

Things are looking up for Jason when he makes a friend in the clinic, while Kim is in turmoil when someone she loves begs her for help. Elsewhere, Theresa gets herself in trouble when she gets a new job, and there’s a revelation at the hospital that changes the lives of those involved forever.

Theresa is relying on a family member when she makes an error of judgement, while it seems Jason’s new friend may not have his best interests at heart. Elsewhere, Lindsey reveals her big plan to Freddie, and Tom puts his relationship with Peri at risk when she gets the total wrong end of the stick.

Leela makes a huge discovery at Peri’s birthday party, but someone steps in to take the blame. Ziggy is left embarrassed when he steps up to the mark to impress the Lomaxes, and Patrick gives Nico an impossible order.

It’s the morning after Peri’s party and the village is shaken by last night’s news. Following the revelation, Leela makes an announcement, leaving two other villagers feeling very awkward. Elsewhere, Jason is faced with his biggest dilemma yet.

Nancy gets too close for comfort and provokes an emotional outburst from a village resident. Maxine receives devastating news that could change everything, and Ste decides he needs to tell the truth about his illness, but worries about how people will react.

Maxine flees with Minnie, but she could be putting her daughter’s life in danger in the process. John Paul’s guilt over Harry begins to spiral out of control when a good deed goes wrong. Elsewhere, Nancy finds herself in the centre of a love triangle… but who will she choose?

Someone is closer to discovering John Paul and Harry’s secret than they realise. Meanwhile, Maxine tries everything to put things right before history repeats itself, and Nancy has made her choice, but is worried she’ll live to regret it.

Robbie is furious when he discovers Joe’s secret, while Joe is shocked by the return of a familiar face. Patrick ropes Theresa in to a wicked plan with an offer she can’t refuse. Harry gets in over his head trying to be someone he’s not.

Lockie gives Ziggy a hilarious new business idea, and it looks like Joe’s luck is about to change for the better, but things might not be all that they seem. And Theresa could find herself in danger when Patrick flies off the handle.

Grace is spooked out by some reminders of Mercedes, while Porsche gets a bit too close for comfort to a guilty Diane. Elsewhere, Ziggy is mortified when a new business venture takes a very awkward turn, while Lockie stumbles on an opportunity to make some money.

Porsche is on the warpath, and her rage has heart-stopping consequences. Lindsey comes close to uncovering a truth, but a secret someone stands in her way. Elsewhere, Lockie is forced to flee the village when he causes trouble with Trevor.

It's decision time for Tom and Peri as the reality of their situation hits, while Lockie teams up with his brother when Porsche is under threat. Elsewhere, Tony is determined to see justice done, while tragedy could be about to strike at the hospital…

Lockie puts himself and Cameron in danger as a heroic act goes horribly wrong, while suspicion causes tension between Charles’ Angels at the hospital. Elsewhere, Theresa’s conscience kicks in over her latest scheme.

Tegan receives some life changing news about her health, while another part of her life is about to crumble. Elsewhere, the pressure is building for Peri and Tom, and Patrick gives Theresa a challenge that puts her in a moral dilemma.

Maxine seems doomed to fail when a secret plot threatens her chances with Social Services. Will a guardian angel be her saviour? Porsche drags a dangerous ally into her bid for revenge against Lockie, and Peri’s mind is made up… until her situation spirals out of control.

A night out with Porsche and Theresa could cost Maxine her future. Meanwhile, it’s a race against time for Darren and Cameron after a shock revelation. Trevor locks horns with a fellow villager as things turn nasty, while Grace is on the warpath. Eeeeeek!

Grace is determined to get to the bottom of Trevor’s betrayal, and Kim gets more than she bargained for when she confronts Grace. Dirk’s torture over the poison pen letter escalates… what is he going to do?! And a surprise intervention leads to a shock result for scheming Patrick.

Dirk’s tormentor could be closer to home than he thought. Fresh clues about the Mercedes case emerge, while Grace and Kim have to deal with the consequences of their actions. Patrick fears for Nico, but is it all as it seems?

It’s a big day for Jason as he finally leaves the clinic. When more truths surrounding Will’s death surface, Dirk is forced to pray the price. Elsewhere, Kim comes dangerously close to blowing things apart for Freddie and Lindsey.

Sinead hits the jackpot when she stumbles across Lindsey’s plan. Robbie finds himself out of his depth, and makes a shock discovery, while Joe ensures the rogue responsible for a recent attack will pay the price. Meanwhile, Jason uncovers fresh leads about missing Freddie.

Robbie goes off the rails, but will anyone come to his rescue before he hits self-destruct? Kim’s scheme could prove detrimental for one Roscoe brother. Desperate Tom clutches at straws, and Lindsey appeals to Sinead… is this the start of an unlikely alliance?

Tegan is speechless when a notorious face turns up on her doorstep. Meanwhile, an astonishing secret is exposed after an impulsive proposal. Elsewhere, someone is out for revenge on the McQueens and will stop at nothing to see the family crumble.

Patrick sees red after a recent revelation. The walls are closing in on one villager as the police gather more evidence surrounding Mercedes’ murder. Meanwhile, Tegan’s condition takes a turn for the worse…

With time running out, Tegan is forced to make some tough decisions. Grace is out for revenge when she discovers that her plans have been thwarted. Elsewhere, a desperate Ziggy is pushed to the limit, and makes a bold decision…
Tony and Diane go in search of answers, while a blast from the past causes havoc for Dr S'Avage. Meanwhile, a frantic Ziggy takes desperate measures…with criminal consequences.

Someone threatens to expose the truth about Dr S'Avage, but what’s his big secret? Reality hits Ste and Leela as they take the law into their own hands. And it’s decision time for Darren - will he do a deal with the devil?

Ziggy’s faced with an impossible decision… what will he decide? Diane’s search for justice has frightening consequences, which put her family in the firing line. Elsewhere, Cindy spies a new romance blooming, while Sienna starts to scheme a way out of the psychiatric unit.

eps.t: All is Fair in Love and War
eps.d: Tegan has to cover her heartbreak when Leela makes an announcement, while Celine plots to keep love on course. Sienna has something planned, and sets her sights on Dr S’Avage, and Maxine and Darren find themselves closer and closer. Jason’s new career brings a surprise revelation for Cindy, which results in devastating consequences.

As Jason leaps to Cindy’s rescue, Darren has his own suspicions about the culprit, and Maxine discovers Darren’s not all he seems. Patrick and Theresa take their working relationship to the next level, and Esther is heart-broken by desperate Phoebe’s situation.

Theresa makes a shocking discovery when doing a good deed, while Darren takes matters into his own hands, but soon finds the police are one step ahead of him. Elsewhere, things are getting worse for innocent Phoebe, leaving Esther desperate to find a way to help her friend.

Patrick gains an ally, but can he trust them to keep his secret safe? Sinead finds herself caught up in a dangerous game when she does a deal with Freddie, while a surprise phone call sends Grace into a panic… her plan is unravelling - fast.

An awkward double booking at The Dog brings two sets of sworn enemies face to face… but there’s a big shock in store when DS Thorpe makes a very public arrest. Elsewhere, in a moment of madness, Kim reveals a dark secret from her past.

Cracks start to show in John Paul’s fairy-tale when Sinead comes between him and Ste. Trevor’s loyalty is pushed to the limit when Grace refuses to abandon her master plan, and Joe is desperate to convince Nancy of the truth after a shocking revelation.

Feeling guilty and alone, Sinead’s emotions threaten to spiral out of control, while Ste re-opens some old wounds, but it’s at a cost to John Paul. Elsewhere, Porsche and Celine attempt to build bridges… but will they be forgiven?

Three is a crowd for Sinead, John Paul and Ste. Cleo pushes boundaries to get back at Harry, a decision she might end up regretting. Meanwhile, Porsche’s buried secrets threaten to resurface, while Diane takes her battle for Rose and Dee Dee to the next level.

Harry braces himself to come clean about one of his many secrets, and Peri panics as her dilemma gets bigger every day. Lockie faces a tough decision to help Porsche, which forces him to choose between his past and his present.

Celine gets more than she bargained for when deep emotions are stirred because of her interfering. Sparks fly for Darren as the search for his mystery woman continues. Elsewhere, Tegan needs to decide whether she should continue to conceal her true feelings or finally confess.

An unwelcome face tells Porsche their plans to stick around. Tensions erupt for Leela over her wedding day plans, while Cameron gets his hands on evidence that could make his dreams come true. Meanwhile, Cindy makes a difficult decision about her future with Dirk.

Cameron’s meddling may have gone too far and Tegan is forced to reveal her true feelings as the pressure mounts. Jason and Cindy get a bit too close for comfort when they use each other as a shoulder to cry on.

Leela starts to blame her loved ones following the recent attack, while jealous forces are out to stop her wedding to Ziggy. Nico and Dylan come up with an idea to cheer Peri up, but it seems like more than just a bit of fun to Dylan. Elsewhere, Theresa tries to call a truce, but Sienna has other plans…
Time is running out for Ziggy at the wedding, but what will his heart decide? Elsewhere, Tegan faces another battle with Diane, while Cameron’s biggest secret could be about to come spilling out…

Patrick and Sienna are in for a shock after a visit to the hospital, while Theresa is approached with a new career prospect. Elsewhere, Cameron has to choose between his pride and his freedom, while Kim’s obsession with Grace continues to grow.

Cameron has met his match, but he won’t go down without a fight. Elsewhere, Theresa faces tough decisions about her future, and Nancy can’t keep Kim’s dark secret for much longer, so decides to confide in someone.
Kim tries to claw her way back into Esther’s affections, while a livid Lindsey sets out for revenge. Elsewhere, Trevor is furious when a video of Dylan goes viral.

Trevor vows to clear Grace’s name… but he’s going to need Darren’s help. Lindsey’s shocked to discover the truth about Kim’s new obsession, as a dark secret from the sisters’ childhood is revealed. Sienna confronts her father over secrets and lies, while Sinead is delighted by the arrival of a flamboyant newcomer.

Lindsey is haunted by reminders of her childhood and resolves to face her demons. Darren double-crosses his family, but a rare act of brotherly love from Joe leaves him guilty. Will Sienna’s revenge on Patrick leave her father in serious trouble?

A new cell-mate threatens to make life difficult for Grace, while Kim reaches rock-bottom in a bid to get her girl. Harry protects Dylan against school bullies, putting his chances of footballing success on the line. A new arrival threatens to come between John Paul and Ste.

Dylan hatches a revenge plan, but doesn't realise that he could end up the loser when things backfire. Porsche’s world crumbles when she realises the past is about to catch up with her. John Paul struggles to reconcile with the new lodger, unaware he’s about to expose his dark secret. Meanwhile, Kim resorts to extreme measures to get closer to her target.

Sinead’s meddling has tragic consequences. Porsche has a plan to protect her sisters, but getting Celine and Cleo on board won’t be as easy as she’d hoped. Grace feels the full force of Kim’s obsession, while Dylan resorts to crime in a bit to conceal his secret.

Harry is rewarded for his silence but the prospect of prison may force him to reveal the truth. Dylan’s secret looks set to be revealed when Trevor makes an intimate discovery, and Diane is charmed by a wolf in sheep’s clothing, but will she wise up before any real damage is done?

Tony is determined to expose the truth about a love-rat, but looks set to embarrass himself instead. Elsewhere, Harry pays the price for tangling with the school bullies, and Esther plays peacemaker but ends up doing more harm than good.

Lockie pushes his luck too far, while it looks like the game is up for Porsche when Tony plays detective. Elsewhere, Zack is disgusted by a schoolyard confession, and John Paul fears he’s lost Ste forever, while Sinead confronts the real culprit.

Sienna tries to build bridges with Nico, but only ends up making things worse. Tegan questions a friend’s motives when he gets too close for comfort, while Zack and Holly’s cunning plan leads to heartbreak. Elsewhere, Lockie’s lies may have gone too far, and Porsche gets a call from Reenie about her release.

Holly’s determined to prove her love to Jason, but it comes at a cost to herself. Elsewhere, desperate Porsche decides her best bet is to play dirty, while Nico puts herself in danger, and gripped by jealousy, Mariam is out for blood.

Sienna teams up with Dr S'Avage , while Mariam suspects someone of murder; could the Gloved Hand killer be revealed? Elsewhere, Holly passes her driving test, while Lockie plots to steal money from Diane to give to a desperate Porsche.

Tegan is furious to bump into an intoxicated Mariam, who is still on the hunt for evidence to condemn Dr S’Avage. Meanwhile, Sienna stumbles into a horrifying situation, Dirk finds out about Cindy’s debts and Simone captures a naughty kiss on Louis’ new drone.
Simone accidentally lets slip Cindy’s big secret to a devastated Holly. Elsewhere, Dr S’Avage is arrested after being found with some very suspicious evidence.

Lockie tries to win Porsche’s forgiveness by organising a surprise BBQ at the McQueens. Threats are being thrown around between Patrick and Sienna, while Tegan is questioned by the police. Meanwhile, Cindy and Dirk finally tie the knot, even after Jason tells Dirk the real reason behind her excessive spending.

The BBQ sets fire to the McQueens and it is a race against time for Phoebe to get Lockie and Porsche out. Elsewhere, Darren is shocked with who he finds in the boot of Trevor’s car, while Freddie taunts Grace knowing he has the upper hand.

It’s Freddie and Lindsey’s wedding day, but a fight between the Roscoe brothers halts the celebrations when Joe bursts into the church. Grace is released from prison and is presented with an engagement ring from Trevor, but the magical moment is short-lived when a betrayal is revealed. Elsewhere, Sinead's waters break.

Tensions are running high in the village when Grace pulls out a gun on Freddie, but the tables are dramatically turned when Joe gets a grasp of the trigger. Patrick is furious to oversee Darren and Maxine kiss but is persuaded by Theresa to apply for joint custody.

It’s the day of Maxine and Patrick’s court hearing for custody of Minnie, and Patrick plans to ruin Maxine’s chances by blackmailing Darren. Sinead’s labour is taking longer than expected so is sent home and, high on emotion, kisses Ste.

Patrick and Maxine fight their case for the custody of Minnie but Patrick’s evil foul play begins when Maxine is found with a water bottle filled with alcohol and is escorted out of the hearing. Elsewhere, Sinead goes in to labour for real on the kitchen floor of The Hutch.

Maxine is devastated when Patrick wins full custody of Minnie and struggles to cope with her emotions. Sinead and Ste bring baby Hay home to the flat, but she becomes worried when she finds out that he’s broken up with John Paul.

Zack’s antics cause an argument in the group, which distracts him from the road, as he accidentally hits a bystander. Meanwhile, Maxine convinces Darren not to go to the police, while Patrick lies to Theresa to keep her onside. Elsewhere, Simone informs Lindsey that she has bought her flat and plans to move in right away.

Kim finds a silky camisole underneath Dylan’s clothes, and Nico jumps to conclusions. Jason tries to get rid of any evidence from the car crash but ends up discovering something a lot worse. Cleo receives some suspicious CCTV footage which makes her doubt Harry, and Freddie tells Lindsey that he has found somewhere for them to live, which could be controversial.

Ben is having issues with his new recruit and decides to do some digging. Nico is fed some lies to protect Dylan’s secret, this backfires and Sienna finds herself in danger. Elsewhere, Harry has to prove himself to Cleo in order to regain her trust.

Dr S'Avage agrees to help Sienna, but after realising the truth about Dylan, Nico begs for Sienna’s forgiveness, but it could be too late. Porsche goes to desperate measures to gather some cash, while Cindy tries to relieve some of Jason’s tension. Meanwhile, Esther is surprised when Kim tells her about Kath.

Sienna regrets her actions, and finds solace in a certain doctor’s arms. Celine gets involved in some dodgy dealings to stop Porsche from going too far, and Reenie arrives in the village. Meanwhile Grace tests Esther’s feelings for Kim to prove a point.

Grace is overwhelmed with jealousy when Dylan’s mum turns up at the hospital. Reenie invites the family to lunch at The Dog and insists she’s staying for good, so Porsche hatches a plan to send her straight back to prison.

Things take a sinister turn when Reenie’s boyfriend Pete arrives at the McQueens and a dark revelation is uncovered. Elsewhere, Grace is in hospital and a love-struck Kim continues with her malicious antics.

Porsche is devastated when Reenie accuses her of lying about Pete’s assault. John Paul offers to babysit baby Hay as Ste struggles to juggle work and fatherhood, while Sinead wishes to reveal her secret crush.

Sinead is convinced that John Paul wants Ste back so she causes havoc to gain Ste’s attention. Sienna helps Dr S’avage clean out Mariam’s house, but finds there are a number of precious items missing.
Cameron and Celine break into Mariam’s house and plan to get a painting back for Dr S’Avage. An argument erupts between Sinead and Ste, which leads him to visit someone from the past.

There’s some awkward chemistry in the air when Cindy begins to pen an erotic novel and ropes Jason into helping her. Ste insists he wants to do the ‘family thing’ with Sinead, and Nico plans a chilling revenge for her mother.
Reenie and Sienna battle it out for a job at Price Slice, whilst Nico collapses in the flat after her malicious plan to hurt her mother goes terribly wrong.
Phoebe’s health is deteriorating as John Paul desperately tries to find a way to get through to her. Elsewhere, Scott is disgusted to hear Sinead wants him to move out of the flat.

Lockie attempts to calm a troubled Porsche from drinking her problems away, but his efforts are wasted when she leaves on a party bus. Elsewhere, John Paul breaks the news of Phoebe’s unconsciousness to a heartbroken Robbie.

Porsche returns home from another night out, grabs Lockie and takes him upstairs to the shock of John Paul who catches them in the act. Dr S’Avage presents a twinkle of hope for the McQueens, but a grief-stricken Robbie endeavours to halt Phoebe’s treatment.
Robbie persists to barricade Phoebe’s hospital room door, while the McQueens desperately struggle to get in. Elsewhere, Tegan is put-out by the return of loved-up Leela and Ziggy.
Thinking that Grace shot Phoebe, Robbie seeks help in getting revenge. Meanwhile, Tegan is furious to see her potential date giving Celine flowers.
Joe decides to hand himself in to the police for shooting Phoebe, while Trevor is distracted in the flat by Val, unaware that Kim’s hidden camera is watching them.
Val makes a move on Trevor and kisses him, which is all caught on camera. At the garage, Mercedes urges Robbie to stop Joe going to the police with a reason he can’t ignore.

During Esther’s baby shower, Kim maliciously shows Grace the photos of Val and Trevor kissing. Elsewhere, Ziggy is seething with jealousy when he returns to find Tegan and Tony getting cosy with a game of Twister.

Grace starts pretending she’s in love with Kim to keep her sweet. Tony arranges a drink with Tegan, only for it to be sabotaged by a jealous ex, but whose? Elsewhere, Scott plans revenge on Ste and Sinead, and Holly realises the messages from Zoe aren’t coming from Switzerland…

Ziggy tries to tell Tegan that Tony is using her, but Tony manages to convince her otherwise. Elsewhere, Dirk fools Cindy into thinking she’s won a writer’s competition. In the Magic Bean, Holly messages ‘Zoe’ and is shocked to see a message arrive on a phone where Louis Loveday is at.

Thinking Louis is behind the messages from Zoe, Holly, Cleo and Harry tell Zack about the folder. Elsewhere, Tegan threatens to flee the village with Rose after getting into an argument with Diane, but is there an even bigger shock in store?
Leela suspects Diane is lying about her whereabouts when Rose was snatched, so she heads to The Hutch for clues. Elsewhere in the village, everyone is shocked when the police make an arrest.
DS Thorpe questions Tegan, while Tony asks Darren to give him an alibi. Elsewhere, Zack is furious when Louis doesn’t stand up for their family, and Ben and Sienna’s relationship continues to bloom.

Accusations are thrown around the village for the kidnapping of baby Rose. During the press conference, Tony suspects the worst and drops Diane in the firing line. Elsewhere, Louis tells Zack they’ve decided to leave Hollyoaks.
Patrick attempts to meddle in Sienna's love life by insinuating that Ben is no good for her. Meanwhile, a hooded intruder is spotted in a family home.

Patrick maliciously flaunts Minnie in the village, but Maxine is stronger than ever with a new business venture to secure a future for her and Minnie. Meanwhile, Jason becomes increasingly jealous of Holly and Zack’s relationship.

eps.t: Should I Stay or Should I Go?
eps.d: An argument erupts between Sienna and Patrick, so Ben gives her the choice to leave with him and offers his hand. Elsewhere, the attraction between Jason and Cindy is uncontrollable.

Pete attempts to fit in within the village, while Porsche is devastated to see Lockie socialising with her abuser. Sienna takes extreme measures after Nico warns her about the possibility of another woman in Ben’s life.
Ben’s past starts catching up with him, while Robbie flies into a fit of rage after a heartbreaking discovery. Elsewhere, Porsche despairs when some sinister secrets bubble to the surface.
The McQueens are in meltdown, but can they pull together for Phoebe’s funeral? Lockie and Porsche are at breaking point, and Mercedes is devastated when Joe gives her a few home truths.

Cleo’s betrayed by someone she thought she was close to, but how far is she prepared to go to save her Mum? Elsewhere, an unlikely hero means Ziggy can attend the audition of his life, and John Paul let’s out his devilish side for the sake of love.

Mercedes decides to confront the truth, which has huge consequences. Elsewhere in the village, Nancy‘s in for a shock from a mystery admirer, and Lindsey takes drastic action when she uncovers a conspiracy that could ruin her future.

Reenie promises to turn over a new leaf, but is it too little too late? Elsewhere, the Roscoes race against time to finally put things right, while Theresa comes up with a wicked scheme, but she could be totally overstepping the mark…
Maxine hears Minnie crying through the window of Patrick's flat, she goes to investigate and sees him collapsed on the floor. Meanwhile, Mercedes and Joe discuss how to tell Lindsey about their baby.

Leela introduces her cousin Angela to the village and gives hope to Peri in finding prospective adoptive parents for her baby. Elsewhere, Patrick’s secret is out when Maxine discovers leaflets about MND.

Prior to the re-opening of The Loft, Grace panics when Kim plasters the walls with photos of them kissing. She confronts her and they share a passionate kiss... but are they alone? Elsewhere, Patrick is furious when Theresa reveals his illness to Darren.

Trevor is shocked to see Dylan wearing women’s clothing and locks him in the flat, so Dylan plans a merciless act of revenge on his father. Meanwhile, Kim spikes Esther's drink with a drug that induces labour.
Trevor lashes out and accidentally hits Dylan for vandalising the new Loft. Elsewhere, Dr S’Avage continues to misread the signs from Sienna and Dirk insists that she only feels sorry for him.
Dr S'Avage finds himself the object of an unlikely suitor’s affections, while another villager has a life changing decision to make. Elsewhere, Reenie has a high price to pay for the night before.

Sienna gives a scheming McQueen a taste of her own medicine, while Grace and Trevor have a devious trick up their sleeves, but can they pull it off? Elsewhere, it’s time for Lockie to choose whether to follow his head or his heart.

Frankie’s interfering threatens to have devastating consequences for Tom and Peri. Cleo visits a familiar face in an act of desperation, and Porsche is out for blood as she plots a cruel act of revenge. Elsewhere, Sienna is helped by a secret saviour.
Leela is on the warpath and Frankie’s meddling tips her over the edge. Cleo is reeled back into a web of deceit, while Tegan is playing with fire when she turns to someone she shouldn’t.

Zack is at breaking point when the Lovedays refuse to let go of the past. Tegan panics when her good deed jeopardises everything, while Ziggy makes a horrifying discovery, but will he keep it to himself?

Heartbroken and distraught, Louis could be about to push his family too far. Ziggy needs to make a life-altering decision when the truth dawns on him, and Harry’s suspicions grow, but will he realise the threat is so close to home?

eps.t: One Step Forward, Two Jumps back
eps.d: When there’s a danger of losing everything, Zack chases after Lisa. Elsewhere, Robbie’s good deed turns into a chaotic nightmare, while Cindy falls head first into her old ways.

Cindy’s mortifying moment has her embarrassed and nervous. Elsewhere, Robbie spies an appealing opportunity and is determined to take action, while Lisa’s stories start to untangle when someone sees something they shouldn’t.

Nico urges Sienna to forgive and forget when Ben attempts to make amends, but does he have underlying intentions? Elsewhere in the village, Nancy is given a lavish gift from a very untrustworthy source.

Extreme measures are taken when Sienna tries to get to the bottom of her lover’s secret, while Jason has to choose between a brother in need and a job he loves. Elsewhere, Holly tries to resist temptation after her actions the night before.

A schoolboy prank upsets Celine, revealing a dark secret, could she be the gloved hand? Meanwhile, Sienna is left reeling when Ben sheds new light on his mystery woman, and wonders whether she might have made a huge mistake. Darren sees red when Patrick gets closer to Maxine.

Sienna and Nico struggle to hold it together in the aftermath of a horrific accident, but does it end there? Cameron and Celine finally get some time alone, while Zack tries to make amends with Lisa and reunites his family.

Sienna fights to keep her cool but Nico looks like she might crumble under the pressure. Unsettled after the events of the previous night, Celine looks like she may slip back into her old ways. Elsewhere, Darren becomes increasingly agitated by Patrick and struggles to keep his temper under control.

Dr S'Avage delivers some crushing news to Patrick, but Maxine continues to show her support. A jealous Kim fumes as Grace and Trevor look set to get their happy ever after. Meanwhile, Jason and Robbie make amends, but Jason struggles to keep his brother on the right path.
Robbie chases after his forbidden love. Elsewhere, Grace and Frankie lock horns over a villager’s latest meddling and Dylan will stop at nothing to prove himself to his father.

Twin rivalry reaches new heights when Robbie and Jason lock horns, resulting in a terrible accident. Elsewhere, Trevor’s determined to get rid of Kim once and for all, and Scott spins a web of deceit to get Ste on his side.
Tom infuriates Peri when he humiliates her at the baby scan. Sparks fly between a forbidden couple, while Grace’s blood runs cold when Frankie gets too close for comfort.

eps.t: A Leopard Never Changes its Spots
eps.d: Frankie has a trick up her sleeve to get her own way, while Leela sees red when she finds out the shocking truth about what Tom’s been up to. Elsewhere, Sinead spots an intimate moment she shouldn’t have – and can’t help but interfere.

Porsche comes up with a secret scheme, and Cleo is torn between her heart and her head when she realises she has some big decisions to make. Elsewhere in the village, Ben’s looking for revenge on Trevor when he’s given a tip-off.

It’s Porsche’s birthday, but there’s trouble brewing, in true McQueen style. Sinead’s interfering goes disastrously wrong due to an awkward case of mistaken identity, while Mercedes flies off the rails when she follows her gut instinct about a lie.

Harry and Ste get a lot closer, while Sinead realises the mistake she has made. Porsche's birthday party doesn’t go to plan when Reenie spoils the decorations. Meanwhile, trouble is around the corner when Mercedes makes a play for Lockie that he cannot resist. Elsewhere, Nico in her frustration lashes out at Dylan.

It is a close call for Lockie and Mercedes when Porsche nearly catches them fooling around. Meanwhile, Scott is punished for his lies and Ste tries to play happy families while Harry looks on. Elsewhere, Maxine is shocked to find evidence that links Sienna to Carly’s murder.

Nico risks spilling everything when Darren and Maxine decide to do some digging. Celine tries to convince Porsche to come home but she is having none of it. Elsewhere, Mercedes and Joe attend their first baby scan and Lockie gets the wrong idea when he finds the scan photo.

Ben asks Sienna to move in with him, but she worries when she sees Maxine with Nico. Meanwhile, Mercedes moves into the Roscoes', and Nancy’s luck changes when she walks in on the Lovedays in a compromising position.

Nancy agrees to help Darren with his big proposal, but things don’t go according to plan. Meanwhile, Patrick goes missing after leaving a note, and everyone fears the worst. Elsewhere, Grace gives Trevor a choice to make, while Dylan receives a shocking threat from ‘GothBoy98’.

Dylan’s blood runs cold when he realises he’s made a massive mistake, while a frustrated Darren is left heartbroken. Elsewhere, Cameron wants to take the next step in his relationship with Celine, but can’t understand why she’s holding back.
A high-speed car chase has explosive consequences for all involved, while Dylan’s gutted when he’s betrayed on his big day, and Esther makes the biggest decision of her life.

Tegan decides it’s time to cut all ties - but will she listen to what her head is telling her? Elsewhere, an embarrassed Celine comes face-to-face with a love rival who needs her help, while Frankie and Jack get a call that changes their whole lives.
Cameron catches Celine red-handed, but will he keep quiet about what he’s seen? Elsewhere, Nico’s behaviour causes Sienna serious concern, while Tom sinks to sinister blackmail to get what he wants.

An unsuspecting Diane is in danger when Tegan sets out on the warpath. Elsewhere, Ste shares a forbidden kiss with an unlikely villager, and it looks like Cameron’s big confession is about to be exposed!

Ste proposes to Sinead and a furious Harry confronts his secret lover at school. Tensions rise, as does the passion, and the pair end up having a steamy kiss. At the end of his tether, Tom sets a revenge plan in motion that’s set to send ripples through the village, and Tony pulls out all the stops to impress Diane.
Peri goes into labour with Cameron and Leela by her side. Elsewhere, Ziggy shares a stolen kiss with someone he shouldn’t, and Celine needs to declare her feelings before it is too late.

Peri overhears Tom tell the baby about how much he loves her, will they hand their newborn over to the Browns? As Celine’s self-esteem crumbles, Pete is satisfied he has her in his clutches. And after a passionate moment Tegan is overjoyed, but will her happiness last?
Harry thinks he is finally going to get what he wants, while Nico is determined to settle the score on a tragedy close to her heart. Meanwhile, Kim’s haunted by visions of Dylan.

Darren is concerned when Theresa makes a comment about Patrick not changing, despite being ill. Nico’s quest for the truth leaves her in grave danger. Elsewhere, as Robbie and Holly get closer, Jason finds it difficult to control his jealousy.

A disastrous mistake sends Jason on a downward spiral. As Leela's lies become more elaborate, she finds herself going to extraordinary measures. Meanwhile, after a shocking revelation, Kim gives herself a creepy make-over.

An unwanted visitor threatens to change everything for Trevor. Elsewhere, it’s Lindsey’s 30th birthday and the Roscoes are in high spirits until a misunderstanding leads to a disturbing consequence, and Darren decides to trust his instinct by seeking the help of an old friend.

Jason puts his heart on the line, while Robbie finds himself in the centre of a sinister scheme. Louis’ concerns for Nico grow as he gives Sienna an unwelcome suggestion, and Patrick gears up for an investors’ reception at the school, but will all go to plan?

Trevor goes to drastic measures to uncover the truth, putting someone in grave danger. Meanwhile Sienna is anxious that Nico will crack under pressure. As chaos erupts at the school, a secret looks set to be exposed.

Lisa’s blood runs cold when a blast from the past returns to the village, meanwhile Nico and Sienna lock horns over Sgt Ben. Elsewhere, shivers run down Reenie's spine when she receives an unexpected phone call.

Nana promises Derek that she won't tell Reenie about her visits, while Lisa's world is turned upside down when her past comes back to haunt her. With emotions at fever pitch, Ben and Trevor lock horns over Carly’s death. Tony is stunned when he discovers a forbidden love letter; a secret affair could be exposed.

Kim sees red when she suspects her sister is slipping away from her. Meanwhile, Zack spots his sister playing a dangerous game. Tensions rise between Nico and Sienna, but will Sienna heed Maxine's warning to protect her daughter?

Zack’s dreams are shattered when a sinister accident has devastating consequences. Lindsey is furious when Freddie ruins a dream opportunity. Joe puts his heart on the line but is it too little too late?
In a unique flashback, secrets bubble to the surface from the Lovedays’ past. Meanwhile, in the present day, Zack fights for his life.

Mercedes tries to comfort Freddie, who is at breaking point with his relationship with Lindsey. Elsewhere, Nancy plays the hero when she rescues a villager from despair. Meanwhile, Ste is forced to face the consequences of his actions.
Freddie attempts to prevent Mercedes from revealing their secret. Reenie is worried after a familiar face returns. Ste's affair ends up having some devastating consequences.
Leela uses some desperate measures in an effort to get her man. Freddie fights for his marriage. Secrets in the McQueens' family are revealed and threaten to rip them apart.
Pete uses some sinister tactics to get Cleo. Reenie finally reveals her shocking secret. John Paul attempts to build bridges with Porsche.

Tegan ends up in trouble after an innocent misunderstanding has some dangerous consequences. Tony finds himself in hot water with the local community and Scott uses it to his advantage. Ziggy pAYS A visitTO an unlikely love rival to try and get some answers.

Tony announces that Hollyoaks will be hosting a big event. Following an accident Leela finds herself on a downward spiral. Cleo visits an unlikely source for advice on her secret relationship with Pete.
Leela attempts to convince a fellow villager to keep her secret. Robbie and Jason's dangerous rivalry hits a whole new level, while Diane is scared that somebody is out to get her.
Dr S'Avage has some disturbing news to share with Diane. Ste is determined to keep his secret. Ziggy is in trouble after he accidentally goes to a gay bar with Tony.

Tony's shock decision could mean that Harry's time in Hollyoaks might be coming to an end. Tegan feels more alone than ever after Ziggy finds out about her betrayal. Leela is in danger after she is accused of committing a crime she didn't commit.
A startling discovery is made by Cindy. Tegan realises that Celine can't let go of the past. Holly continues to make some bad decisions with devastating consequences.
Dr S'Avage has to face the truth after his darkest suspicions are confirmed. Dirk takes matters into his own hands with Trevor. Peri finds it hard to deal with her new role.
The gloved killer makes a move on their next victim. Patrick finds it hard to come to terms with his illness.
Peri takes some drastic measures to make sure she gets what she wants.
Peri ends up making a panicked decision that surprises Jack, Tom and Nancy. Patrick finds an unlikely friend who helps him to take control of the way he is feeling.
Lisa worries that Jade will blow her cover. Carly's funeral causes a destructive spiral for Nico.
Nico realises that her sinister plan has backfired horribly. Lisa is concerned after Jade works out who her secret crush is.
Kim is left reeling after her plans backfires. Cleo's jealousy takes over after she makes a shocking discovery. Sienna and Nico look like they are about to get themselves into trouble.
Pete is concerned that his sinister secret could be about to be exposed. Ste and Harry's relationship suffers after Tony starts to meddle. Robbie begs a familiar face to come back to the village.
Lindsey is left feeling shocked by her discovery. Trevor takes drastic action to get his old life back. Harry treats Ste to a naked surprise, but it backfires after somebody shows up unexpectedly.
A dangerous criminal is back in town and is out for blood. Nancy faces a dilemma that could leave somebody's career on the line. Freddie is out for revenge.
Jason's jealousy leaves his brother in serious danger. Ashley sets her sights on her next victim and is determined to get what she wants.
Tony announces 'Hollyoaks Pride' open and there is a fanfare of fireworks. Joe discovers a forbidden plan after he overhears a secret conversation. Trevor gets ready for a fresh start.
Trevor is out for blood after he learns about a wicked betrayal. Mercedes feels torn over a difficult dilemma. Somebody is closing in on the gloved killer.

There's no escape for three of the villagers as they work out that their lives are in serious danger. Ben comes up with a plan to try and snare Trevor. Diane and Tony hope to get their fairytale ending.
Grace wants Esther to give her one last chance to be a mum. Darren is suspicious about Jack's behaviour.

The Osborne family are furious with Jack's decision. A new family shows up in the village. Grace panics after an old friend tracks her down and she scared that her secret could be about to be revealed.
The Roscoe family are lest feeling broken following what happened at Hollyoaks Pride. Jack hands over the keys to the pub. Lockie needs a favour from Leela as he attempts to help Cameron.

After an unwelcome visitor shows up in the village, it looks like Ellie's plans are ruined. Tegan and Ste receive a nasty surprise after they turn up for Cameron's sentencing. Scott manages to get on the wrong side of Tony.
Ellie's scheming could end up ripping her family apart after Rachel catches her red-handed. Scott opens up to Diane about his past. Tegan realises it's make or break time for her and Ziggy.
Patrick looses it after he and his new school replacement clash. Peri issues Tom with a life-changing ultimatum. Cameron is determined to get the woman he truly loves.
Maxine causes a riot after she feels someone has been treated unjustly. Pete takes his manipulation to the next level as he purchases Jade a devious present.

Boiling with rage, Sienna sets out to prove that Maxine is taking her dad for a fool. Elsewhere, Nico and new arrival Alfie hit it off instantly much to older brother Nathan’s disapproval. Meanwhile, Nancy is furious when Darren lets his family down at the moment they need him the most.

Alfie attempts to impress Nico but his plans go dangerously wrong, while Jason begins his own private investigation. Elsewhere, after a heated row with Joe, Mercedes floors him with a spiteful lie. Meanwhile, Sienna is stunned when Patrick lets her in on a dark secret.
New arrivals the Nightingales have a few tricks up their sleeves, while Alfie gets a lovely surprise. Elsewhere, John Paul and Mercedes decide to get answers on a delicate situation.
Lisa’s heart is shattered when she walks in on her crush getting flirty with Theresa. Meanwhile, Maxine is adamant she will stand by Patrick whatever the cost and Nico tries to track Jason’s plan.

Theresa is in turmoil when an intimate snap gets posted online, but this is just the beginning of her troubles. Meanwhile, Ben has a fight on his hands when more villagers hear that there might be a killer amongst them.

Lindsey comes up with a wicked scheme to cover her tracks when her Gloved Hand secret is under threat. Lisa begs Theresa to think about her safety when she puts herself in danger for money to help her family. Elsewhere, John Paul’s career hangs in the balance at the disciplinary, and it’s down to Harry to help him.

eps.t: What Do We Have Here Then?
eps.d: Holly and Robbie are forced to think fast when their forbidden affair is about to be exposed, while Lisa’s plan backfires as she puts herself in the firing line for a friend. Elsewhere, Grace sets out on a mission – but where do her loyalties really lie?

Grace pushes Charlie for answers, but with the Gloved Hand right behind her, she could be doing herself more damage than she realises. Ste reveals the latest news about his HIV to John Paul, while Robbie puts his heart on the line when he pushes Holly for answers.
Ste knows all eyes are on him when he turns up at Harry’s 18th birthday party in The Loft, while Jason panics when secrets from Phoebe’s shooting look set to be unearthed during Ben’s investigation.

Mercedes and the McQueens are surprised when Mummy Myra returns, while Cleo pushes Pete to come clean to Reenie as their wedding looms. Elsewhere, Joe sets his sights on getting his woman once and for all.

A (rather dishy) new face arrives in the village searching for his mystery love, while Myra helps to put things right between Joe and a heartbroken Mercedes. Elsewhere, Cleo makes a shocking discovery that threatens to halt Reenie and Pete’s wedding, and the Nightingales have no idea what they’ve let themselves in for when they go head to head with The McQueens.

Cleo is at breaking point on the day of Reenie and Pete’s wedding, while Cindy turns to an unlikely villager for help in a desperate attempt to keep her two husbands apart. Elsewhere, Jade worries she’ll be rejected by the Osbornes after an altercation.

The McQueens are broken at the wedding when Pete’s secrets are revealed, causing a traumatised Celine to collapse. Elsewhere in the village, Jade begs Lisa to help her stay in Hollyoaks, but her sister’s hands may already tied.

Cindy realises her time is running out, so she makes an unlawful move that could change her life, while Porsche decides to save her family. Elsewhere, Jade reaches out to a familiar face, not realising she’s putting herself in the heart of danger.

Mac sets a date to marry Neeta but a certain spoilt family member will stop at nothing to make sure the wedding doesn’t go ahead. Cleo’s loyalties are divided when the McQueens get some shocking news, while Lisa struggles to keep up her lie when she comes close to betraying her true identity.

Cindy confides in Lindsey when she finds some suspicious evidence on her phone, while Nathan confronts Mac about his supposed affair. Elsewhere, fake Lisa panics when her true identity risks being uncovered, and Nancy starts to fall for Darren again.

Sparks fly for a very unlikely couple, when Darren and Grace take part in a Single Mingle night at The Dog. Elsewhere, Cindy tries to enlist the help of Simone but Lindsey tampers with her medication.

Esther encourages Nancy to reveal her feelings to Darren, while Lindsey tries to manipulate Dirk into sending Cindy away to a specialist centre. Alfie wants Neeta to adopt him but Mac isn’t so sure, and the Lovedays receive a poison pen letter in the post.

In a panic, Lisa reveals her true identity to Theresa who threatens to tell the Lovedays, and Louis finds a second blackmail letter and is spooked. Elsewhere, Grace manages to get between Nancy and Darren, while Peri and Leela finally make up.

Louis has a secret meeting with a woman from his past, who attempts to blackmail him for money. Elsewhere, Lisa prepares to tell her family the truth, while Tegan returns to Hollyoaks with a new boyfriend, much to Ziggy's annoyance.

It’s Leela’s birthday but the celebrations turn sour when she makes it her mission to uncover the truth about Tegan and Ziggy. Elsewhere, Louis tries to shake off his unwelcomed visitor, but soon discovers she won’t leave without a fight, while Nico burns with jealousy at the sight of Jason and Holly.

Cameron sets out to prove his love to Celine, but a secret admirer threatens to come between them. John Paul discovers the secret that Mrs St Claire was trying so hard to keep buried, while Leela is on the warpath at the Lomaxes’ after last night’s shock revelations.

eps.t: Always the Bridesmaid, Never the Bride
eps.d: Alfie finds himself tangled in a weird love triangle when a romantic gesture goes very wrong, while Tegan decides to go after her man, but instead gets a nasty surprise that breaks her heart. Elsewhere, Mrs St Claire feels betrayed when she thinks John Paul has exposed her secret.

Patrick takes his sinister scheme to a new level when he notices Jason’s curiosity, while the Lomaxes are broken when there’s still no word from the missing family members. Elsewhere, as the tormenting continues, Holly finds comfort with a forbidden friend.

Harry's jealous when he sees Ste and John Paul getting close again. Patrick’s blood runs cold when something threatens to throw his master plan off course, and Robbie decides it’s time for the truth to come out.

Nico’s rage spirals out of control, leaving Sienna to bear the brunt of her fury. John Paul reluctantly tries to put his and Ste’s relationship behind him, while Holly suspects Robbie of acting out of jealousy.
A drunken Ste makes a public declaration of love for Harry, but will it go to plan? Meanwhile, Ellie makes a dangerous new enemy in the form of Myra McQueen, and Diego appears to be hiding something.

With Jason in the palm of his hand, Patrick cranks up his scheme to frame Maxine. Meanwhile, a suspicious Myra is left feeling confused after overhearing a hushed conversation, and Pete asks Cleo for one last favour.

At the Christmas bar crawl, Ellie is on a mission to sabotage Rachel’s relationship with Nathan. Elsewhere, Reenie and Celine search for Cleo, after Harry exposes her secret, while Maxine has a surprise announcement for Patrick.
Mercedes and Joe return to the village in true Hollyoaks fashion, and Nancy makes a painful sacrifice for Darren. Meanwhile, a shocking discovery makes Cleo’s blood run cold.

Reenie and Porsche encourage Cleo to do the right thing and talk to the police. After a fall out with Mercedes, a vulnerable Joe finds himself at the mercy (pun defo intended) of manipulative Lindsey’s charms, while Nancy is brimming with jealousy over Darren and Grace’s blossoming friendship.

Louis receives a card from Joanne which sends him frantic. Lindsey is furious as she witnesses Mercedes and Joe growing closer. Nancy is overcome with emotion when she finally is honest about her feelings.
Ste and Tony fall out. Louis covers up Joanne's tracks. Kim makes a shocking comeback, shocking the Roscoes.
Tony and Ste begin to rebuild their friendship. Celine makes a blunder when she gets the wrong end of the stick. Dirk confronts Louis.
Lindsey will stop at nothing to ruin what Mercedes and Joe have. Tony and Tegan help Ste out. Cameron plans a surprise.
Reenie receives a letter she wasn't expecting. Tegan is heartbroken when someone close to her is rushed to the hospital. Celine's festive cheer evaporates quickly.
Lisa is jealous over Theresa and Zack. Porsche is floored by what she finds out. John Paul reflects on the pact he has made with Ste about meeting up on Christmas Day.

Cameron will stop at nothing in order to ensure that he is still part of Peri's life. Lockie fears for Porsche who is struggling to come to terms with what she has discovered. Lisa decides to come clean.

Ste realises he has to choose between John Paul and Harry. Reenie and Porsche say goodbye to Hollyoaks. Lisa finds that her lies have spiraled too far out of control. Tegan hopes to have a merry Christmas.
Peri feels as though her family is lying to her. Lindsey is delighted to have her man to herself, that is until someone returns. Lisa's world crumbles around her.
Lisa and Zack are forced to spend time together. Alfie makes a surprising breakthrough whilst trying to find out who his real parents are. Patrick wants a final favour from Maxine.
Alfie sets a plan in motion to finally uncover the truth. Sienna locks horns with the McQueen girls over Patrick. Lindsey sees red.

On the day of Tom's 16th birthday, Esther is desperate to come clean to her crush. Darren finds leaflets from the hospital and it concerns him that they are been hidden by someone close to him. Kim wants to stop Lindsey before she has the chance to strike again. Ellie celebrates the New Year with a stranger.
Sienna tells Ben about Patrick’s plan to die. Elsewhere, Darren takes Nancy on a ‘first date’ and ends up putting his foot in it, while Grace tries to make amends with Esther.
Patrick lays the final pieces in place of his plan. Joe has second thoughts about his love life. Darren tries to sweep a lucky lady off their feet.
Maxine doesn't know whether to keep her promise as the day of the ceremony is here. Nico makes a discovery.

Maxine finds herself getting closer to the edge, as Patrick casts a dark shadow over the family. Nancy spots a meeting between two ex-lovers, leaving her heartbroken. Sienna rushes to try and save Nico.
Darren and Maxine are in over their heads as the lies spiral out of control. Tony takes on Alfie at the Hutch. Ellie thinks she has found out Cindy's secret.
Cindy knows her secret is a ticking time bomb as Mac and Neeta prepare to take their vows. Harry and Myra come together to get Cleo back on the right path. Tony makes a discovery.
Ben is suspicious of Darren's story. Cleo discovers the past is hard to get over. Dirk and Holly turn their back on Cindy.
Cindy is promised a lifeline by a new face in the village. Alfie feels rejected as Tony wants to keep his secret buried. Harry finds out why Cleo has been behaving the way she has and he's furious.

A villager returns unannounced, throwing a spanner in the works for the loved-up Lomaxes. Holly and Robbie's affair is taken to the next level. Pete uses dirty tactics to try and get back into the good books.
Cameron and Leela's passionate moment is ruined. Cindy and Ellie lock horns over Mac's past. Holly may have to reveal all to Jason.

Cameron feels the pressure to prove himself at the Mr and Mrs Contest held at the Dog. Pete tries to keep Cleo in the palm of his hand. Harry crumbles and Tony blames Ste, causing their rift to grow deeper.
Lindsey has a new plan in mind to sabotage Mercedes and Joe's relationship.
Grace tries to prove a point. Louis thinks that Mrs St Claire's anger may lead her into doing something drastic.
Mercedes become suspicious. Lindsey's scheme begins to work.
The whole community is on the line as Trevor's case heads to court. Ben may of lost his job.
Ben grows angry. Grace and Esther are shocked by the latest development in Trevor's case.
Grace doesn't know if she's ran out of time to find Trevor. Ellie overhears Myra's secret and decides to have some fun with it. Nancy puts her foot in it. Alfie tries comforting Jade.
Jade's 16th birthday party goes off with a bang as she waits on some life-changing news with the Osbornes.

Ellie's mischief threatens to ruin two relationships. Nancy believes that Darren is hiding something. DS Thorpe has fresh news on Patrick's disappearance and shares kit with Sienna, Nico and Maxine. Two villagers can't fight their feelings anymore.
Cindy needs James more then she realises. Maxine is frightened when she hears a voice from the past at Patrick's memorial. Joanne has news for Simon that makes Louis heart sink.
Maxine continues to be spooked by strange occurrences. Nancy tries to get Darren's attention again. Joanna feels rejected by Louis and so decides to plot her revenge.

eps.t: Face to Face with the Enemy
eps.d: Simone gives Louis the silent treatment. Jade's putting on a front that soon collapses behind closed doors. Mac can't believe the lengths Cindy is going to in order to ruin him.
It may be a little too late for a peace offering to be made by Tony to Harry. Maxine is summoned by Mrs St Claire alongside Nancy and Sienna. Mac feels the pressure.

Lindsey faces up to the glove handed killer's witness. Alfie struggles to come to terms with recent revelations. Darren and Nancy have some bad news for Charlie, but they soon discover he's hiding a dark secret of his own.

Celine wants Tegan to be a part of the new hospital poster campaign. A familiar face makes their return to the Dog. Lindsey takes drastic measures by eyeing up her next victim, hoping to not be put in the frame for the other murders.
Trevor isn't happy about been in trouble with the law again. Lindsey see's an opportunity that she can't miss. Celine, Kim and Tegan are surprised at the new face on the hospital posters.
Jason thinks he's walked in on Holly cheating on him. Tegan is spooked when she has a visitor at the hospital. Lindsey gets a call from beyond the grave.
Kim is terrified when she hears what Lindsey has planned next. Robbie, Jason and Joe think they may of seen a ghost. Trevor struggles with what's going on in his head.
Darren and Trevor get their wires crossed as Daren gets defensive about Grace. Alfie comes up with a plan to help Grace with her book report. Ellie has feelings for someone.
John Paul realises he has to choose between his head and his heart. Ellie sets her sights on her next suitor. Simone has to make a choice between family life and work.
There's a dramatic showdown between Ben and Trevor in the Loft. Joanne has a plan to get Louis to herself. Cleo asks for a job at the Hutch.
Grace will stop at nothing until she gets her revenge. Simone's lies are exposed leading to a confrontation between her and Louis. Theresa is mortified when she finds Zack in bed with someone.

Reenie is suspicious when she discovers that Pete has been talking to the police. Marnie sets her sights on the Hutch. Zack is red-faced about his night of passion and is concerned whether Theresa will keep it quiet.
Cleo lands in turmoil with Tony, as she binds over Pete. Zack opens up about his feelings. Marnie and James seize an opportunity to progress in their plan.
Cindy saves the day as Holly and Jason's wedding reaches crisis point. Marnie and James discover the way to bring down the Hutch. Tony pities Cleo.

eps.t: You Can Leave Your Hat On
eps.d: Holly is jealous when Robbie hires a stripper for Jason's stag do. Dirk comes to the rescue at the Dog. Pete is attacked by a hooded figure.
Holly is forced to choose between the two brothers on her wedding day to Jason. Joe makes a discovery that makes him think twice about Lindsey. Diane isn't happy about what Scott is hiding.
Alfie doesn't know what secrets his broken laptop is hiding and is determined to fix it. Jason and Holly are devastated. Scott hopes to save the day when Tony reveals all to Diane.
Freddie remembers something which means the game might be up for Lindsey. Alfie tries to face his fears at the charity abseil. Peri isn't happy when Cameron gets strict.
Lindsey thinks she has a way to silence Freddie and prepares a syringe. Cameron and Peri get confrontational. Alfie and Jade get swept up in the moment.
Cameron tries winning Peri back. Alfie and Jade's romance blossoms. Jack receives a bizarre delivery.

Jade is shocked at the cancer support day. The villagers reel as another suspect in the murder cases is arrested. Lindsey comes face to face with a visitor. James hopes Scott will form part of his plan that will spell disaster for The Hutch.

Darren tries to get to the bottom of were Jade's money has gone. Lisa ignores her feelings for Zack as Simone sets him up on a dating site. Nathan finds out about James and Marnie's plans of sabotaging The Hutch.

Things get steamy between Zack and Lisa. Simone discovers something shocking. Darren falls back into old habits, but he's trying to do the right thing. Tony tries to save the Hutch, Alfie discovers something heart-breaking.

Lisa worries that her secret may be exposed when a face from the past reappears. Ben tries to find a kidney donor for Nico. Grace can't sympathise with Trevor's PTSD, as he grows ever closer to Sienna.
Sienna and Trevor continue to try and push off their feelings for one another. Joanne finds a way back in with the Lovedays. Nico puts her plan into action.

Grace decides to take matters into her own hands, and Trevor is shocked to find her standing over Sienna’s lifeless body. Meanwhile, Cameron realises that Tom and Peri have been left alone together, and storms in to find them kissing. Elsewhere, Diego suggests that he and Myra should have a baby one day.

Trevor worries that the forensics might find his DNA on Sienna’s body, while Grace packs his bags and asks him to leave. John Paul is shocked by the news that Diego and Myra are thinking of having a baby.

All eyes are on Ste when Cameron plants a bag of cocaine in Rose’s baby changing bag, while an anxious Tom pushes Peri away. Elsewhere, Trevor begins having second thoughts about leaving Grace, and Mrs St Claire invites lonely John Paul for a drink.

Scott decides to become a children’s entertainer to help raise money for The Hutch, and Darren offers Tony gambling advice. Meanwhile, Ste tries to plead his innocence but not even Harry believes him.

John Paul lies to Mrs St Claire and heads out on a date with a mystery man, but he’s shocked to see him at the school later. Cameron is determined to find out what Tegan’s hiding when he catches her in a tricky situation. Elsewhere, Tony chooses a dangerous route when he tries to save The Hutch.

John Paul deceives Mrs St Claire, but who is the mystery new man? Cameron finds Tegan in an awkward situation, he is determined to discover what she is hiding. Tony decides to resort to desperte measures to try and save The Hutch.

John Paul is convinced someone has a crush on him but is he going to be able to avoid his admirer? Darren is nervous when Tony's new business venture threatens to expose dark secrets. Disater strikes as Scott messes around in The Hutch.

Myra is left stunned by a shocking discovery. Alfie attempts to do the right thing when he's faced with the return of his cancer. John Paul helps pick up the pieces, and is surprised to lern there is more to happy-go-lucky Scott.
Joanne threatens to expose Lisa's identity. Diego is stunned to discover Myra's has been twisting the truth. Alfie and Jade stand united against their cancer.
Myra braces herself for financial windfall. Rachel pushes Alfie to tell his family the truth. Lisa pleads with Joanne to keep her secrets.

Louis is in shock as his suspicions about Joanne spiral out of control. A case of mistaken identity has humiliating consequences for Steve. Elsewhere Jason is left heartbroken after yet another revelation.
Jason clashes with Holly and the Savages at The Hutch. Simone supports her husband's claims. Kim asks Esther for a favour.
Lisa attempts to come clean about her true identity. Ste and Harry's relationship is put to the test. Esther is shocked to discover a surprising secret about Lindsey.
Alfie finally finds out about his test results. Rachel is feeling guilty about going behind the Nightingales' backs. Elsewhere Ellie offers Cindy a beauty treatment.
The Nightingales pull together after a revelation. Marnie overhears a conversation she is able to use to her advantage. Holly is left shocked by Robbie's suggestion.

It's a race against time for Holly as she puts her life in danger to follow her heart. Robbie and Jason have an important decision to make, and hot newcomer Liam sets pulses galloping when he meets Tegan and Celine.

Following a high-speed chase, there's terror as a car explodes - but who's trapped inside? Celine wastes no time in showing the new villager to the hot tub, but could there be romance on the cards for Tegan too?

Alfie prepares for his first chemo session, and Jade has news about her own diagnosis. Liam ends up in a pickle when his double-crossing is finally exposed. Freddie has his heart set on Ellie, but does she feel the same?

Celine is determined to get her man, but a surprising intervention leaves her heartbroken. Lindsey's on edge when Esther comes clean about her visit to Kath, and a canny Marnie advises Ellie not to trust Freddie.

Mercedes arrives back in the village, and she wants answers. Kim is terrified that Lindsey is feeling murderous again. Freddie plans to take Ellie on another date, but Marnie gives him food for thought - what hold does she have over him?
Darren spins a web of lies when he's caught out. A furious Freddie overhears a hushed conversation, and Mercedes's suspicions are growing, but will her fears be taken seriously?

Kim's world begins to crumble when she realises she has been betrayed. Joe prepares a romantic setting for his proposal, unaware that he is in grave danger. Tegan and Celine join forces in a bid to get revenge.
Esther fights for Kim's innocence, Joe is derailed by Mercedes's latest claims and Lindsey's escape from Hollyoaks takes a wicked turn.
The Osbornes wait for Frankie to return, unaware of what's happened. Meanwhile, Esther attempts to be the hero and Lindsey threatens to kill again.
As Frankie's life hangs in the balance, will Lindsey make her great escape? When his romantic gesture turns sour, Zack comes clean about his true feelings. Cindy attempts to play Cupid.
Sienna worries that Nico is on to her as she tries to get a confession. Simone and Louis try to patch things up, but there's a huge shock in store for them when a secret is finally revealed.

The Lovedays are in crisis following the shock revelation. Sienna and Trevor's illicit love affair hots up, but is Grace about to catch them red-handed? Ste and Harry vow to cheer up Grace, with hilarious consequences.
Louis, Simone and DS Thorpe turn up to interrogate Joanne. Sienna and Trevor plan to leave Hollyoaks together - will they get their happy ending? Ste and Harry contemplate a night sleeping rough.
Darren's concerned about Maxine - can she keep quiet about their terrible secret? Joanne meets up with Margaret, who abducted Lisa all those years ago. James catches Ste and Harry in a bind.
Darren and Nancy worry that someone knows their secret - who could it be? Marnie warns Freddie to stay away from Ellie. Esther cringes as Frankie tries to put her own stamp on The Magic Bean.

Things turn sinister when the Osbornes receive another blackmail note. Grieving Nathan gets drunk and lashes out at Holly, and Freddie puts his heart on the line to impress Ellie - but will she give him one last chance?
It's the day of Rachel's funeral and Nathan is overwhelmed with emotion. Marnie warns Freddie to stay away from her daughter, and Kim is a nervous wreck waiting for Lindsey to pounce.
Esther encourages Kim to do the right thing, and Leela's new business venture is a success until Ste meddles with his ulterior motives. Nathan demands that Cleo face justice.

Cleo struggles to deal with the fall-out from the crash, but when Pete tempts her with an offer, will she be able to resist? Simone is knocked for six when she returns to a nightmare in her home. Kim gets another text from Lindsey - what will she do?
Tony watches helplessly as The Hutch crumbles. Myra warns Sally to stay away from their son. When Holly's suspicions over Cleo grow, nothing prepares her for what she discovers.

Scott is devastated after overhearing a private conversation, while Holly realises she needs to make a sacrifice to save Cleo from Pete. Harry is blown away by an indecent proposal, but will he be tempted?
Manipulative Marnie convinces Scott to take desperate measures to help Tony, while Zack locks horns with James. Ste's temper gets the better of him, but could Cameron end up having the last laugh?

After a night in the cells, Ste's luck goes from bad to worse as a blast from his past arrives in the village. Scott is playing with fire as he tries to help Tony, while 'Dirty' Harry makes a decision that could end things with Ste once and for all.

The morning after the night before, foiled fire starter Scott discovers Marnie's true intentions and guilt-ridden Harry has cash in hand - but at what cost? Distrustful Sonia and Zack steal Joanne's laptop, never suspecting the secret they find hidden among her emails.

Love is in the air as Frankie sets Esther up with an unexpected date, while Bridezillas Grace and Sienna exchange a war of words; but can Sienna keep her feelings for Trevor under wraps? And, as Joanne comes clean, the Lovedays' world is rocked by an unexpected arrival.

Sparks fly when the real Lisa Loveday comes face to face with identity-stealing Sonia, while Grace and Sienna argue over their wedding dress crisis. Kim asks Esther for another chance but does she have an ulterior motive?

Lisa is refusing to let go of her life with Margaret, but the Lovedays are ready to fight for their daughter. Sienna feels like the walls are closing in as her wedding day draws closer. When Ellie and Freddie play Cupid have they unwittingly put baby JJ in danger?

Lindsey goes to desperate measures to get closer to JJ, while Freddie and Ellie's attempt at a romantic night in is thwarted. Trevor is shocked to discover that Sienna is babysitting Curtis - what is she up to?
When Sienna rushes to Trevor's aid, will she make him see they're meant to be together? Alfie has a surprise up his sleeve for Jade's last chemo session, but will his plan backfire?

Frankie tries everything in her power to keep Alfie and Jade apart, but does the teenager need her soulmate more than Frankie realises? Leela asks Cameron to cover for her at The Loft. And Sienna tells Trevor that he has to decide who he really wants.
It's the day of Sienna and Ben's wedding, but is she marrying the wrong man? Marnie plays the wolf in sheep's clothing by making an irresistible suggestion.
When John Paul reveals something shocking to Ste, it confirms Ste's growing suspicions. Alfie lends a helping hand to Jade, while Tony puts it all on the line in a bid to save The Hutch.
Scott is heartbroken when he realises John Paul is ashamed of him, while Jade's illness takes a dramatic turn. Ste has an accident, leaving Cameron with a dilemma.
At the hospital, Alfie and Jade face the repercussions of their actions, while Myra and Mrs St Claire lock horns over John Paul. Leela worries about what has happened to Ste.
Tony's troubles cause him to spiral out of control. Myra thinks Sally is interfering in John Paul's life, leading to a face-off. A dangerous villager returns - but what are they up to?

When Mercedes conjures up another get-rich-quick scheme, she meets her match in an unlikely villager. Pete's ultimatum leaves Cleo conflicted, while Silas and Lindsey's wicked plot is in danger of being foiled.
Cleo has a big decision to make and Kim pleads with a shocked Celine and Tegan for their help, while Mercedes is in for a horrible shock.
Scott has a proposition for John Paul. When a petrified Mercedes bares her soul to her old nemesis, it has devastating effects for someone.
A conflicted Freddie has a big decision to make, while things get heated when Myra and Sally St Claire clash. Cleo's actions spark a showdown that exposes a huge secret.
John Paul decides he's had enough and gets tough, Esther comforts Kim, while Tony and Diane are forced to make a life-changing decision.
It's Grace's hen party and Sienna makes a life-changing decision. Scott confesses a secret that has heartbreaking results.
Grace's wedding hits a bump in the road. When Nico's world starts to fall apart, she lands someone with a bombshell, while James attempts to woo his latest conquest.

eps.t: Get Him to the Church on Time
eps.d: It's the wedding of the year, but will the groom make it in time? Can John Paul do enough to save a relationship?
As shocking news spreads across the village, an innocent person finds themself in trouble. Meanwhile, has James made a deal with the devil?
Ellie decides to play Cupid again, but will her arrow hit its target? Celine is forced to become a detective when Cleo tries to outsmart her. Sienna is rocked when a lie is exposed.
It's sentencing day for Cleo and she is nervous as to what the future holds for her. Will Nathan get justice for Rachel? Grace is suspicious when two blasts from her past turn up at her door.
Cindy goes to great lengths to get Dirk back, while Marnie wants to help her son move on with his life. Maxine is on tenterhooks when DS Thorpe gets friendly with Jack.
Will Cindy be able to save the day when The Emporium falls foul of the law? How much longer will Cleo be able to keep Holly's secret? Zack's loyalty is torn between Sonia and Lisa.
As a confident Tony prepares for a job interview, Darren suspects Tom has a crush on Jade, while things come to a head between Sonia and Lisa.

Ste feels dejected when he finds out that Harry has lied to him. Jade and Alfie play Cupid, but is this what Tom really wants? Lisa tells Sonia that she won't stop tormenting her until she leaves for good.
Ste makes a discovery about Harry and James, while Cameron is angry when he thinks Leela is out with another man. Lisa is unhappy when Louis questions her behaviour.

eps.t: You're Cordially Invited To the Launch of...
eps.d: When Louis's suspicions spiral over Lisa, it sparks a breaking point for Simone. Jack and Mac are determined to keep Jade and Alfie apart but the lovestruck teens have other ideas. Fed up with Cameron's angst, Leela decides to have some fun.

Tegan offers Freddie a shoulder to cry on when she sees him struggling. Mercedes does her best domestic goddess impression. Ste has to dig deep to find strength when Cameron leads him into temptation.
Cameron will stop at nothing to chip away at Ste's will power. Will Leela come clean to Tegan? John Paul desperately tries to avoid Sally, but his attitude might put his career on the line.
Mercedes and Joe are faced with a life-changing decision as John Paul prepares to deal with his mistake. Sienna sets her sights on helping Grace, but does she have an ulterior motive?
Diane is left speechless by what she sees at Marnie's flat. Maxine worries that she's let a secret slip, and Grace makes a shocking discovery about Trevor.
As Grace and Sienna prepare for Trevor's funeral, Grace has another visitor in the village. Nancy and Darren play Cupid with Maxine and Dirk - but what will Cindy say?
